original_quote: The dissemination of antimicrobial resistance can be described as a two-step process. First, de-novo mutations or acquisition of resistance genes, or both, occurs via mobile genetic elements, such as plasmids mediating an antimicrobial-resistance phenotype. Second, antimicrobial resistance contagion—the spread of resistant strains—proceeds via several vectors (eg, human beings, insects, birds, agriculture, and water). Selection pressure caused by antibiotic consumption is an important primary factor not only for the de-novo emergence of antimicrobial resistance but also for the selective multiplication of resistant bacteria. Reducing inappropriate antibiotic consumption is a recognised policy priority, and substantial efforts are focused on controlling antibiotic usage volumes in hospitals, the community, and the agricultural sector. Although antibiotic usage has been shown to be an important driver for increasing antimicrobial resistance levels, the spread of resistant bacteria or the genes that encode for resistance are likely to be much more important in the dissemination and prevalence of antimicrobial resistance. The environment (including transmission via water, insects, animals, and birds) plays an underappreciated part in the development and spread of resistant bacteria. (Introduction-p.e398); "Reduction of antibiotic consumption will not be sufficient to control antimicrobial resistance because contagion—the spread of resistant strains and resistance genes—seems to be the dominant contributing factor. Improving sanitation, increasing access to clean water, and ensuring good governance, as well as increasing public health-care expenditure and better regulating the private health sector are all necessary to reduce global antimicrobial resistance." (Interpretation-p.e399); "Our data suggest that globally, a high prevalence of antimicrobial resistance can be more likely attributed to the dissemination of antimicrobial resistance, especially via poor sanitation and contaminated potable water. This expectation is supported by the strong association between the infrastructure index and E coli resistance because E coli are faecal bacteria and their presence in water indicates human or animal faecal contamination." (Discussion-p.e402)

original_quote:
High temperature can affect the permeability of cell membranes, denature protein structures, and inactivate metabolic enzymes, resulting in the inability of some sensitive microorganisms to survive (Cruz-Paredes et al., 2021; D'Alo et al., 2021). profiles. ARG diversity decreased significantly with elevated temperature. The growth of microbes is temperature-dependent (Cruz-Paredes et al., 2021), and it could be promoted bywarmer temperature until their optimum temperature is reached after which growth will slow down (BÁRcenas Moreno et al., 2009). The decrease of ARG diversity may result from the death ofmicrobes that cannot tolerate high temperature.

mechanism_chain_original: 宿主体温(42-43°C家禽肠道 vs 25°C环境如表层水、土壤、粪便样本、牛奶、冷藏生肉) → 影响C. coli红霉素耐药自然转化频率。42°C(家禽肠道体温) → C. coli与供体DNA(来自红霉素耐药C. coli 1800r,携带23S rRNA基因A2075G突变)混合 → 5小时孵育 → DNA结合到受体细菌表面 → DNA内化进入细胞 → 通过同源重组整合到23S rRNA基因 → 获得红霉素耐药(MIC ≥256 μg/ml) → 转化频率为10^-5级别(Fig. 1)。25°C(环境温度如表层水、土壤) → C. coli与供体DNA混合 → 5小时孵育 → DNA结合受损(DNase I处理实验提示1小时后DNA仍未内化,易被DNase I降解) → DNA内化受损 → 整合后步骤受损(即使DNA在42°C 1小时内化后,转移到25°C 4小时仍无法产生转化子) → 转化频率极低(10^-7级别)或检测不到(菌株961和3237)(Fig. 1, Fig. 3)。作者强调:"Temperature had a profound effect, with the frequency of transformation being significantly higher at 42°C than at 25°C for all three strains (P≤0.01). For two of the strains (961 and 3237), no erythromycin-resistant transformants were detected following transformations at 25°C" (Results-p.6122)。DNase I处理实验提示:25°C时DNA结合和内化受损(1小时后DNase I处理无转化子);即使DNA在42°C 1小时内化,转移到25°C 4小时后仍无转化子,提示整合后步骤也受温度影响(Fig. 3; Discussion-p.6124)。37°C时转化频率比42°C降低71%,32°C时降低96%,提示42°C是最佳转化温度(Discussion-p.6123)。萘啶酸耐药转化频率在42°C和25°C时相似或最多相差4倍(菌株1702rnd在需氧条件下42°C比25°C高4倍,但菌株3237无差异)(Fig. 2),提示萘啶酸耐药转化不受温度显著影响。作者推测23S rRNA基因片段单链DNA的二级结构在25°C时受限,影响其摄取和整合,而gyrA片段(萘啶酸耐药突变位点)不受此影响(Discussion-p.6124)。
original_quote: Temperature had a profound effect, with the frequency of transformation being significantly higher at 42°C than at 25°C for all three strains (P≤0.01). For two of the strains (961 and 3237), no erythromycin-resistant transformants were detected following transformations at 25°C (Fig. 1). (Results-p.6122); "As the temperature decreased from 42°C to 37°C, transformation frequency decreased by 71%, and a 96% decrease was noted at 32°C" (Results-p.6122); "When DNase I was added to the mixture of cells and donor DNA following an hour of incubation at 25°C, no transformants could be obtained regardless of whether the mixture was maintained at 25°C or shifted to 42°C for four additional hours (Fig. 3), suggesting that at 25°C, DNA failed to become internalized during 1 hour of incubation and, thus, was susceptible to DNase I. Transformants also failed to be produced when DNase I was added after one hour of incubation at 42°C and the mixture was then shifted to 25°C for four additional hours (Fig. 3), suggesting that steps subsequent to DNA internalization (i.e., after the first hour of transformation) were inhibited at 25°C as well." (Results-p.6123); "Our findings suggest that 42°C may be the optimal temperature for transformation to erythromycin resistance since a significant drop in transformation frequency was noticed even at 37°C. Thus, transformation to erythromycin resistance may take place much more efficiently in the gastrointestinal tract of poultry, whose body temperature is 42 to 43°C, than in other habitats where temperature may be lower, such as surface water, soil, excreted fecal samples, milk, and meat (e.g., refrigerated raw meat or poultry)." (Discussion-p.6123); "It is tempting to speculate that uptake and integration via homologous recombination of the 23S rRNA gene fragments harboring the mutation are impaired at 25°C, due to limitations on the secondary structure of the target molecules at that temperature." (Discussion-p.6124)
effect_direction_original: 1-促进AMR (42°C促进红霉素耐药转化) / 2-抑制AMR (25°C抑制红霉素耐药转化)

title: Differential Effects of Temperature on Natural Transformation to Erythromycin and Nalidixic Acid Resistance in Campylobacter coli
pathway_level_2_corrected_original: 1a-生长代谢；1b-突变率；1c-水平基因转移
pathogen: 美国北卡罗来纳州火鸡源空肠弯曲杆菌(Campylobacter coli strains 3237, 1702rnd)
amr_outcome_original: 萘啶酸耐药转化频率在42°C和25°C时相似(菌株3237)或最多相差4倍(菌株1702rnd在需氧条件下); 微需氧和需氧条件下转化频率无显著差异; 转化频率在10^-5至10^-4级别; DNase I处理实验提示仅DNA结合和内化步骤(前30分钟)受温度影响(42°C比25°C高约4倍),整合后步骤不受温度影响
mechanism_chain_original: 环境温度(42°C家禽肠道 vs 25°C环境如表层水、土壤、粪便样本、牛奶、冷藏生肉) → 对C. coli萘啶酸耐药自然转化频率影响较小。42°C或25°C → C. coli与供体DNA(来自萘啶酸耐药C. coli 1800r,携带gyrA突变)混合 → 5小时孵育 → DNA结合到受体细菌表面(此步骤在42°C时略快于25°C,30分钟时约4倍差异) → DNA内化进入细胞 → 通过同源重组整合到gyrA基因 → 获得萘啶酸耐药(同时耐环丙沙星和其他氟喹诺酮类) → 转化频率在42°C和25°C时相似(菌株3237)或最多相差4倍(菌株1702rnd)(Fig. 2)。DNase I处理实验(Fig. 4)提示:在42°C或25°C孵育30分钟后加入DNase I,42°C时转化频率约为25°C的4倍,提示DNA结合和内化步骤在42°C时略快。但30分钟后(DNase I加入后)的孵育温度(42°C vs 25°C)不影响转化频率,提示整合后步骤不受温度影响(Discussion-p.6123-6124)。作者强调:"In contrast to what was observed with transformation to erythromycin resistance, strain 3237 was transformed with similar frequencies to nalidixic acid resistance at 42°C and at 25°C under either aerobic or microaerobic conditions (Fig. 2). The largest observed impact was a fourfold increase in the transformation frequency of strain 1702rnd under aerobic conditions at 42°C compared to that at 25°C" (Results-p.6122-6123)。萘啶酸耐药C. coli通常同时耐环丙沙星和其他氟喹诺酮类(Discussion-p.6123)。作者推测gyrA片段(萘啶酸耐药突变位点)的单链DNA二级结构不受25°C温度限制,因此萘啶酸耐药转化在家禽肠道(42°C)和环境(25°C)中均高效发生(Discussion-p.6124)。这一发现提示氟喹诺酮耐药通过自然转化的获得可能在各种生态位(家禽肠道、环境、其他动物宿主)中频繁且一致地发生,而红霉素耐药转化主要发生在家禽肠道(Discussion-p.6123)。
original_quote: In contrast to what was observed with transformation to erythromycin resistance, strain 3237 was transformed with similar frequencies to nalidixic acid resistance at 42°C and at 25°C under either aerobic or microaerobic conditions (Fig. 2). The largest observed impact was a fourfold increase in the transformation frequency of strain 1702rnd under aerobic conditions at 42°C compared to that at 25°C (Fig. 2). (Results-p.6122-6123); "Transformation frequency was about fourfold higher when the mixture of cells and donor DNA was incubated at 42°C for the first 30 min prior to the addition of DNase I than it was at 25°C. However, the incubation temperature (42°C versus 25°C) of the transformation mixture after the first 30 min did not affect transformation frequencies (Fig. 4), suggesting that the step(s) subsequent to the internalization of DNA were not affected by temperature (42°C versus 25°C) in transformation of C. coli 1702rnd to nalidixic acid resistance." (Results-p.6123); "It is of interest that transformation to nalidixic acid resistance was either not significantly affected or affected to only a modest (fourfold) extent by temperature (25°C versus 42°C). Nalidixic acid-resistant C. coli isolates are typically also resistant to ciprofloxacin and other fluoroquinolones. The results from transformation to nalidixic acid resistance suggest that acquisition of fluoroquinolone resistance through transformation may occur frequently and consistently in a wide range of CO2 concentrations and temperatures, both in animal hosts and in the environment. Thus, acquisition of fluoroquinolone resistance in Campylobacter through transformation may occur frequently in various niches, whereas transformation mediated acquisition of high-level resistance to erythromycin may be much more common inside avian hosts than in animals with lower body temperatures or in the environment." (Discussion-p.6123); "It is tempting to speculate that uptake and integration via homologous recombination of the 23S rRNA gene fragments harboring the mutation are impaired at 25°C, due to limitations on the secondary structure of the target molecules at that temperature... On the other hand, in the case of erythromycin resistance, the target DNA involves fragments of the 23S rRNA genes, and single-stranded DNA fragments with these sequences would be expected to harbor extensive secondary structure." (Discussion-p.6124)
effect_direction_original: 1-促进AMR (42°C和25°C均高效促进萘啶酸耐药转化)

title: Differential Effects of Temperature on Natural Transformation to Erythromycin and Nalidixic Acid Resistance in Campylobacter coli
climate_factor_original: 温度-变化 (42°C vs 25°C); CO2浓度-变化 (微需氧5-10% CO2 vs 需氧0.03% CO2)
pathogen: 美国北卡罗来纳州火鸡源空肠弯曲杆菌(Campylobacter coli strains 961, 3237, 1702rnd)
amr_outcome_original: 微需氧(5-10% CO2)和需氧(0.03% CO2)条件下转化频率无显著差异(P>0.05); 红霉素耐药转化频率在微需氧和需氧条件下相似(42°C和25°C均如此); 萘啶酸耐药转化频率在微需氧和需氧条件下相似(42°C和25°C均如此); 需氧条件下5小时孵育不影响受体细菌活力
mechanism_chain_original: CO2浓度(微需氧5-10% CO2 vs 需氧0.03% CO2) → 对C. coli红霉素和萘啶酸耐药自然转化频率无显著影响。微需氧条件(5-10% CO2,C. coli的最适生长条件) → C. coli与供体DNA混合 → 5小时孵育 → 转化频率为10^-5级别(红霉素耐药)或10^-5至10^-4级别(萘啶酸耐药)(Fig. 1, Fig. 2)。需氧条件(0.03% CO2,非最适生长条件) → C. coli与供体DNA混合 → 5小时孵育 → 转化频率与微需氧条件相似(P>0.05),且5小时孵育不影响受体细菌活力(基于孵育前后CFU测定)(Results-p.6123)。作者强调:"No significant differences (P>0.05) in frequency of transformation to either erythromycin or nalidixic acid resistance were observed between microaerobic (5 to 10% CO2) and aerobic conditions (P>0.05) (Fig. 1 and 2). The 5-h incubation period under aerobic conditions did not affect the viability of the recipient, based on CFU determinations immediately prior to and at the completion of this period" (Results-p.6123)。转化子在微需氧和需氧条件下均获得高水平红霉素耐药(MIC ≥256 μg/ml),与供体C. coli 1800r相似(Results-p.6123)。本研究结果与Wilson等人(2003)的发现不同:Wilson等人发现C. jejuni转化为氯霉素耐药的效率随CO2浓度从10%降至0.7%而增加10-100倍。作者推测差异可能源于弯曲杆菌种类和菌株、转化的抗生素耐药标记、实验条件(包括CO2浓度范围)的不同(Discussion-p.6124)。本研究表明,在微需氧(5-10% CO2)和需氧(0.03% CO2)条件下,C. coli的红霉素和萘啶酸耐药自然转化频率无显著差异,提示CO2浓度(在该范围内)不是影响转化频率的关键因素。
original_quote: No significant differences (P>0.05) in frequency of transformation to either erythromycin or nalidixic acid resistance were observed between microaerobic (5 to 10% CO2) and aerobic conditions (P>0.05) (Fig. 1 and 2). The 5-h incubation period under aerobic conditions did not affect the viability of the recipient, based on CFU determinations immediately prior to and at the completion of this period (data not shown). At 42°C, the frequencies of transformation to erythromycin resistance were similar under microaerobic and aerobic conditions with the agar assay as well (data not shown). Transformants had high-level erythromycin resistance (MIC, ≥256 μg/ml), regardless of whether they were obtained under microaerobic or aerobic conditions. (Results-p.6123); "Wilson et al. found that the efficiency of transformation of C. jejuni to chloramphenicol resistance increased by 10- to 100-fold as CO2 concentration declined from 10% to 0.7%. In our study, we showed that transformation was equally effective under microaerobic (5 to 10% CO2) and aerobic (0.03% CO2) conditions, suggesting that these differences in CO2 concentrations did not significantly affect transformation. Differences in the Campylobacter species and strains that were used, the antibiotic resistance markers that were transformed, and the experimental conditions, including the CO2 concentration range, may account for the difference in findings between the study of Wilson et al. and this study." (Discussion-p.6124)
effect_direction_original: 中性 (CO2浓度在5-10% vs 0.03%范围内不影响转化频率)

title: Differential Effects of Temperature on Natural Transformation to Erythromycin and Nalidixic Acid Resistance in Campylobacter coli
pathogen: 美国北卡罗来纳州火鸡源空肠弯曲杆菌(Campylobacter coli)
amr_outcome_original: C. coli通过自然转化获得红霉素高水平耐药(MIC ≥256 μg/ml),转化子携带23S rRNA基因A2075G突变(与供体C. coli 1800r相同); 转化频率在42°C时为10^-5级别,25°C时为10^-7级别或检测不到; 火鸡源C. coli转化频率高于猪源C. coli; C. coli中红霉素和氟喹诺酮耐药比C. jejuni更常见,原因不明; 23S rRNA基因点突变导致红霉素耐药,gyrA点突变导致氟喹诺酮耐药
mechanism_chain_original: 自然转化机制 → C. coli从环境(如其他C. coli携带的裸露DNA)获得抗生素耐药基因 → 通过DNA摄取和同源重组整合到基因组 → 获得抗生素耐药表型。红霉素耐药转化:供体DNA(来自红霉素耐药C. coli 1800r,携带23S rRNA基因A2075G突变) → 受体C. coli摄取供体DNA → DNA在42°C时有效结合和内化(1小时内) → 通过同源重组整合到23S rRNA基因(3个拷贝之一或多个) → 转化子获得23S rRNA基因A2075G突变 → 导致高水平红霉素耐药(MIC ≥256 μg/ml)(Introduction-p.6121; Kim et al., 2006引文)。25°C时DNA结合和内化受损,整合后步骤也受损,导致转化频率极低或检测不到(Results-p.6122-6123; Discussion-p.6124)。萘啶酸耐药转化:供体DNA(来自萘啶酸耐药C. coli 1800r,携带gyrA突变) → 受体C. coli摄取供体DNA → DNA在42°C和25°C时均有效结合和内化 → 通过同源重组整合到gyrA基因 → 转化子获得gyrA突变 → 导致萘啶酸耐药(同时耐环丙沙星和其他氟喹诺酮类)(Introduction-p.6121; Discussion-p.6123)。作者强调:"In previous studies, we showed that C. coli from animal sources could acquire high-level resistance to erythromycin via transformation, with transformation frequencies being higher among turkey-derived C. coli than among C. coli from swine. Transformants acquired the A2075G mutation in the 23S rRNA gene that was harbored in the 23S rRNA genes of the erythromycin-resistant bacteria employed as sources of donor DNA for the transformations" (Introduction-p.6121)。C. coli中红霉素和氟喹诺酮耐药比C. jejuni更常见,原因不明(Introduction-p.6121)。自然转化可能对C. jejuni的遗传多样性和抗生素耐药传播有重要贡献(Introduction-p.6121)。
original_quote: Campylobacter is known to be naturally competent, and studies with C. jejuni have suggested that transformation (uptake of naked DNA) may make a significant contribution to genetic diversity. Transformation may also be important in the dissemination of antibiotic resistance in Campylobacter. In previous studies, we showed that C. coli from animal sources could acquire high-level resistance to erythromycin via transformation, with transformation frequencies being higher among turkey-derived C. coli than among C. coli from swine. Transformants acquired the A2075G mutation in the 23S rRNA gene that was harbored in the 23S rRNA genes of the erythromycin-resistant bacteria employed as sources of donor DNA for the transformations. (Introduction-p.6121); "Point mutations in 23S rRNA genes and in gyrA are involved in resistance to erythromycin and (fluoro)quinolones, respectively, in Campylobacter. For reasons that remain unclear, such resistance is noticeably more common in C. coli than in C. jejuni." (Introduction-p.6121); "Transformants had high-level erythromycin resistance (MIC, ≥256 μg/ml), regardless of whether they were obtained under microaerobic or aerobic conditions. Erythromycin MICs for these transformants were similar to those for C. coli 1800r (≥256 μg/ml), used as the source of the donor DNA." (Results-p.6123); "Nalidixic acid-resistant C. coli isolates are typically also resistant to ciprofloxacin and other fluoroquinolones." (Discussion-p.6123)
effect_direction_original: 1-促进AMR (自然转化促进抗生素耐药获得和传播)

title: Differential Effects of Temperature on Natural Transformation to Erythromycin and Nalidixic Acid Resistance in Campylobacter coli
pathogen: 美国北卡罗来纳州火鸡源空肠弯曲杆菌(Campylobacter coli)
amr_outcome_original: 单一标记(如仅研究萘啶酸耐药转化)可能导致对环境因素(如温度)影响的错误评估; 红霉素耐药转化受温度显著影响(42°C>>25°C),萘啶酸耐药转化受温度影响较小(42°C≈25°C); 需要进一步研究确定环境因素对其他遗传决定因素(如致病性和其他适应性)转化的影响程度
mechanism_chain_original: 使用单一抗生素耐药标记研究环境因素对自然转化的影响 → 可能导致对环境因素重要性的错误评估。例如:如果仅研究萘啶酸耐药转化 → 会得出温度对转化频率影响较小的结论(42°C和25°C时转化频率相似或最多相差4倍) → 错误地认为温度是相对不重要的因素。但如果同时研究红霉素耐药转化 → 会发现温度对转化频率有显著影响(42°C时转化频率为10^-5级别,25°C时为10^-7级别或检测不到) → 正确地认识到温度是重要的环境因素(Discussion-p.6124)。作者强调:"The findings from the current study clearly indicate that the elucidation of environmental factors influencing transformation in Campylobacter will be important for further characterization of the ecological constraints on the dissemination of antimicrobial resistance in this organism. In addition, these findings imply that the use of one marker to study environmental factors affecting transformation frequency in Campylobacter may lead to pitfalls. For example, temperature would be mistakenly considered as a relatively insignificant factor in transformation, if only transformation to nalidixic acid resistance were studied. Further studies are needed to determine the extent to which environmental factors such as temperature may affect transformation of other genetic determinants, including those involved in pathogenesis and other adaptations of this pathogen." (Discussion-p.6124)。本研究表明不同抗生素耐药标记(红霉素vs萘啶酸)对温度的响应不同:红霉素耐药转化受温度显著影响,萘啶酸耐药转化受温度影响较小。这一发现提示环境因素对不同遗传决定因素转化的影响可能不同,需要使用多种标记来全面评估环境因素对自然转化的影响。进一步研究需要确定环境因素(如温度)对其他遗传决定因素(如致病性基因、其他适应性基因)转化的影响程度,以更全面地理解环境条件对弯曲杆菌自然转化和遗传多样性的影响。
original_quote: The findings from the current study clearly indicate that the elucidation of environmental factors influencing transformation in Campylobacter will be important for further characterization of the ecological constraints on the dissemination of antimicrobial resistance in this organism. In addition, these findings imply that the use of one marker to study environmental factors affecting transformation frequency in Campylobacter may lead to pitfalls. For example, temperature would be mistakenly considered as a relatively insignificant factor in transformation, if only transformation to nalidixic acid resistance were studied. Further studies are needed to determine the extent to which environmental factors such as temperature may affect transformation of other genetic determinants, including those involved in pathogenesis and other adaptations of this pathogen. (Discussion-p.6124)
effect_direction_original: 1-促进AMR (理解环境因素对转化的影响有助于理解AMR传播)

pathogen: 印度德里地区霍乱弧菌(Vibrio cholerae O1 biotype El Tor serotype Ogawa, V. cholerae O139, non-O1 non-O139)
amr_outcome_original: 霍乱病例在5-6月达到高峰(最高峰),其次是7-8月; 病例通常在4月开始出现,在夏季和季风季节(5-9月)达到高峰,11月减少; 冬季干燥月份(1-3月)通常无病例; 2002年3月出现3例病例(异常提前); 1998-2002年共分离431株霍乱弧菌(423株V. cholerae O1, 2株V. cholerae O139, 6株non-O1 non-O139); 90.25%的菌株对至少一种抗生素耐药
mechanism_chain_original: 冬季干燥月份(1-3月,气温低、降水少) → 德里地区通常无霍乱病例 → 提示霍乱弧菌在低温干燥环境中生存和传播能力降低。4月(气温开始升高) → 霍乱病例开始出现。夏季(5-6月,气温高) → 霍乱病例达到最高峰 → 提示高温促进霍乱弧菌在环境(如水源)中的生存、繁殖和传播。季风季节(7-8月,降水增加) → 霍乱病例达到第二高峰 → 提示降水增加导致水源污染加剧、霍乱弧菌通过受污染水源传播增加。9-11月(气温降低、降水减少) → 霍乱病例逐渐减少。本研究结果与Singh等人在德里地区的研究一致:病例通常在4月开始出现,在夏季和季风季节(5-9月)达到高峰,11月减少;冬季干燥月份(1-3月)通常无病例(Discussion-p.250)。2002年3月出现3例病例(异常提前),可能与该年气候异常(提前升温或降水)有关。1998-2002年共分离431株霍乱弧菌,其中423株V. cholerae O1 biotype El Tor serotype Ogawa(98.1%),2株V. cholerae O139,6株non-O1 non-O139,提示El Tor生物型Ogawa血清型在德里地区占绝对优势。90.25%的菌株对至少一种抗生素耐药,萘啶酸耐药率最高(71.38%),环丙沙星耐药率最低(6.92%),提示季节性流行期间抗生素选择压力促进耐药菌株富集和传播。
original_quote: Cholera is endemic in Delhi and is a highly seasonal disease. Our study agreed with the studies done by Singh et al., in that cases usually start appearing in the month of April, attain a peak during summer and the monsoon seasons (May to September) and decline by the month of November. The dry winter months (January to March) in Delhi are usually free from disease, although unusual occurrence of cholera was reported in January in 1994. In the present study, three cases of cholera occurred in the initial part of March 2002, a month before the beginning of the usual cholera season. (Discussion-p.250); "The highest number of cholera cases occurred during May-June followed by July-August (Figure 1). In 1998-2001, cases started appearing in April. However, in 2002, three cases occurred in the month of March, all in the first week of the month. The peak incidence of the disease was observed in May and June of each year, except in the year 2002 when disease incidence peaked in March-April (see Figure 1). The months of January and February were completely free from the disease in all the years." (Results-p.250); "Of 3213 diarrhoeal stool specimens processed from 3213 suspected cases of cholera, 431 (13.4%) were found positive for V. cholerae; 423 due to V. cholerae O1 biotype El Tor, two due to V. cholerae O139 and six due to V. cholerae non-O1 non-O139. All the V. cholerae O1 isolates were serotype Ogawa." (Results-p.249-250); "Only 42 strains (9.73%) were sensitive to all the antibiotics tested and the other 389 (90.25%) strains were resistant to one or more antibiotics." (Results-p.250)

title: Seasonality and antimicrobial resistance pattern of Vibrio cholerae in a tertiary care hospital of North India
pathogen: 印度德里地区霍乱弧菌(Vibrio cholerae O1, O139, non-O1 non-O139)
amr_outcome_original: 90.25%的菌株对至少一种抗生素耐药; 萘啶酸耐药率最高(71.38%平均耐药率,95% CI 53.34-89.42%),其次是呋喃唑酮(57.04%,95% CI 36.22-77.86%)、复方新诺明(55.56%,95% CI 22.06-89.06%)、氨苄西林(47.48%,95% CI 9.78-85.18%)、四环素(24.52%,95% CI 11.04-38.00%)、庆大霉素(18.16%,95% CI 4.60-31.72%)、氯霉素(17.24%,95% CI 9.34-25.14%)、诺氟沙星(14.10%,95% CI 3.18-25.02%); 环丙沙星耐药率最低(6.92%,95% CI 3.28-10.56%); 2株V. cholerae O139对氨苄西林和萘啶酸耐药,但对四环素、诺氟沙星和环丙沙星敏感; 多重耐药菌株(对氨苄西林、复方新诺明、呋喃唑酮、萘啶酸ACoFzNa耐药)在印度多个地区(Bhillai、Ahmedabad、Allephey、Chennai、Vellore、Dibrugarh)广泛传播
mechanism_chain_original: 霍乱治疗中广泛使用抗生素(如四环素为首选药物,氯霉素、呋喃唑酮、复方新诺明为替代药物) → 对霍乱弧菌产生选择压力 → 促进耐药菌株在患者肠道中富集 → 耐药菌株通过粪便排泄进入环境(如水源) → 通过受污染水源传播给新的宿主 → 季节性流行期间(夏季和季风季节)抗生素使用增加 → 耐药菌株富集和传播加剧 → 导致90.25%的菌株对至少一种抗生素耐药(Table 1)。高耐药率药物(萘啶酸71.38%、呋喃唑酮57.04%、复方新诺明55.56%、氨苄西林47.48%)反映这些药物在霍乱治疗中广泛使用和选择压力累积。四环素耐药率达到24.52%,提示作为首选药物的四环素需要密切监测(Discussion-p.250)。呋喃唑酮和萘啶酸是儿童霍乱治疗的首选药物(四环素不推荐用于儿童),其高耐药率(57.04%和71.38%)是一个重大关切(Discussion-p.250)。环丙沙星和诺氟沙星的低耐药率(6.92%和14.10%)提示氟喹诺酮类药物可作为多重耐药霍乱的替代治疗药物,但需要保留使用以避免耐药性快速发展(Discussion-p.250-251)。多重耐药菌株(对ACoFzNa耐药)在印度多个地区广泛传播(Discussion-p.250),提示耐药菌株通过人群流动、受污染水源等途径在地理上扩散。V. cholerae O139出现后,V. cholerae O1分离株的耐药谱扩大,对多种药物产生耐药(Discussion-p.251),提示不同血清型间可能存在耐药基因的水平转移。
original_quote: Although the use of antibiotics in the treatment of diarrhoeal disease is controversial, they do seem to play an important role in the management of critically ill patients. While tetracycline is the drug of choice for cholera, chloramphenicol, furazolidone and co-trimoxazole are the other reported alternatives. In the present study, a high rate of resistance to ampicillin, co-trimoxazole, furazolidone and nalidixic acid (ACoFzNa) was observed. Gastroenteritis due to V. cholerae O1 strains with a similar profile of resistance i.e. ACoFzNa have previously been reported in strains isolated from Bhillai, Ahmedabad, Allephey, Chennai (Madras), Vellore and Dibrugarh. The appearance of resistant strains of V. cholerae to furazolidone and nalidixic acid is a matter of great concern, as these are the drugs of choice for children where tetracycline is not recommended. In the current study, resistance of almost a quarter of V. cholerae isolates to tetracycline necessitates its close monitoring as a drug of choice. (Discussion-p.250); "An interesting finding of note in the present study is the low level of resistance of V. cholerae to the fluoroquinolones, i.e., ciprofloxacin and norfloxacin (6.92% and 14.10%, respectively) including the two O139 strains which were sensitive to both the antibiotics. This is in agreement with recent studies which report no resistance of V. cholerae O1 and O139 strains to ciprofloxacin and intermediate resistance of V. cholerae O1 to norfloxacin. However, ciprofloxacin is an important substitute drug for treatment of multidrug-resistant enteric and other pathogens and needs to be kept in reserve." (Discussion-p.250-251); "Only 42 strains (9.73%) were sensitive to all the antibiotics tested and the other 389 (90.25%) strains were resistant to one or more antibiotics." (Results-p.250); "It was shown that V. cholerae isolated after the epidemic of V. cholerae O139 had an expanding R type with resistance to a variety of drugs as compared to the O1 strains isolated before the advent of V. cholerae O139." (Discussion-p.251)
spatial_context_original: 3-临床环境 (印度德里AIIMS医院急性水样腹泻患者)

title: Seasonality and antimicrobial resistance pattern of Vibrio cholerae in a tertiary care hospital of North India
pathogen: 印度德里地区霍乱弧菌(Vibrio cholerae O1 biotype El Tor serotype Ogawa, V. cholerae O139, non-O1 non-O139)
amr_outcome_original: 1998-2002年共分离431株霍乱弧菌:423株V. cholerae O1 biotype El Tor serotype Ogawa(98.1%),2株V. cholerae O139(0.5%),6株non-O1 non-O139(1.4%); 所有V. cholerae O1分离株均为Ogawa血清型,未检出Inaba血清型; 2株V. cholerae O139分别于2001年4月和8月分离; V. cholerae O1 biotype El Tor serotype Ogawa在德里地区占绝对优势(98.1%); non-O1 non-O139血清群参与引起类霍乱腹泻疾病(6株,1.4%); V. cholerae O139出现后,V. cholerae O1分离株的耐药谱扩大
mechanism_chain_original: 环境因素(温度、降水、水源污染) → 影响不同血清型霍乱弧菌在环境(如水源)中的生存、竞争和传播 → 导致V. cholerae O1 biotype El Tor serotype Ogawa在德里地区占绝对优势(423株,98.1%),所有V. cholerae O1分离株均为Ogawa血清型,未检出Inaba血清型(Results-p.249-250)。V. cholerae O1 Ogawa和Inaba血清型均可引起霍乱,但在特定地理区域和时间段,某一血清型可能占优势,这与血清型间的竞争优势、环境适应性、人群免疫状态等因素有关(Discussion-p.250)。V. cholerae O139于1992年在印度出现,作为新的致病性血清型引起霍乱流行,但在本研究中仅检出2株(0.5%,分别于2001年4月和8月分离),提示V. cholerae O139在德里地区未成为优势流行株。non-O1 non-O139血清群传统上被认为很少参与引起霍乱样疾病,但本研究检出6株(1.4%),提示这些血清群参与引起类霍乱腹泻疾病不应被低估,特别是在V. cholerae O139出现后(Discussion-p.250)。V. cholerae O139出现后,V. cholerae O1分离株的耐药谱扩大,对多种药物产生耐药(Discussion-p.251),提示不同血清型间可能存在耐药基因的水平转移,或V. cholerae O139的出现改变了霍乱弧菌群落的选择压力环境,促进耐药菌株富集。
original_quote: Of 3213 diarrhoeal stool specimens processed from 3213 suspected cases of cholera, 431 (13.4%) were found positive for V. cholerae; 423 due to V. cholerae O1 biotype El Tor, two due to V. cholerae O139 and six due to V. cholerae non-O1 non-O139. All the V. cholerae O1 isolates were serotype Ogawa. (Results-p.249-250); "Currently, cholera may be caused by both the Ogawa and Inaba serotypes of the El Tor biotype of the V. cholerae O1. However, the majority of isolates belong to serotype Ogawa. In the present study, all the V. cholerae O1 belonged to serotype Ogawa and no serotype Inaba were encountered." (Discussion-p.250); "Vibrio cholerae O1 and O139 serogroups are the well known aetiological agents of epidemic cholera and focus on non-O1 non-O139 serogroups has always been low. Considering that six isolates of V. cholerae in the current study were non-O1 non-O139, the participation of these serogroups in causing cholera-like diarrhoeal illness should not be underestimated particularly after the emergence of O139 Bengal." (Discussion-p.250); "The two isolates of V. cholerae O139 were obtained in April and August 2001." (Results-p.250); "It was shown that V. cholerae isolated after the epidemic of V. cholerae O139 had an expanding R type with resistance to a variety of drugs as compared to the O1 strains isolated before the advent of V. cholerae O139." (Discussion-p.251)

title: Seasonality and antimicrobial resistance pattern of Vibrio cholerae in a tertiary care hospital of North India
pathogen: 印度德里地区霍乱弧菌(Vibrio cholerae)
amr_outcome_original: 长期监测项目(1998-2002年5年监测)对识别霍乱弧菌流行病学变化和抗生素耐药模式趋势至关重要; 特定地理区域的季节性分布和抗生素耐药模式知识有助于制定流行期间的适当措施; non-O1血清群的药物敏感性模式应特别关注,因其对V. cholerae O1分离株有影响; V. cholerae O139流行后,V. cholerae O1分离株的耐药谱扩大
mechanism_chain_original: 长期监测项目(如本研究1998-2002年5年监测) → 系统收集和分析霍乱弧菌分离株的流行病学数据(季节性分布、血清型分布)和抗生素耐药模式 → 识别流行病学变化趋势(如血清型转变、季节性模式变化、异常提前流行如2002年3月病例) → 识别抗生素耐药模式趋势(如多重耐药菌株出现和传播、高耐药率药物如萘啶酸71.38%、呋喃唑酮57.04%、四环素24.52%) → 为制定流行期间的适当措施(如抗生素使用指南、预防控制策略)提供科学依据 → 指导临床治疗决策(如选择低耐药率药物如环丙沙星6.92%、诺氟沙星14.10%作为替代治疗药物) → 促进合理使用抗生素(如保留氟喹诺酮类药物使用以避免耐药性快速发展) → 减缓耐药性发展和传播。作者强调:"It is amply clear that long-term surveillance programmes are essential in the identification of changes in the epidemiology of V. cholerae and the monitoring of trends in antimicrobial resistance patterns of V. cholerae strains isolated in endemic localities. The drug susceptibility patterns of non-O1 strains should be particularly watched, as this has bearing on V. cholerae O1 isolates. It was shown that V. cholerae isolated after the epidemic of V. cholerae O139 had an expanding R type with resistance to a variety of drugs as compared to the O1 strains isolated before the advent of V. cholerae O139. Thus, a knowledge of seasonal distribution and antibiotic resistance pattern of V. cholerae isolates in particular geographical region would help in the delineation of appropriate measures required during epidemics." (Discussion-p.251)。本研究通过5年监测识别出德里地区霍乱的季节性分布模式(4月开始出现,5-6月高峰,7-8月第二高峰,11月减少,1-3月无病例)、血清型分布(V. cholerae O1 Ogawa占98.1%)、高耐药率药物(萘啶酸71.38%、呋喃唑酮57.04%、复方新诺明55.56%、氨苄西林47.48%、四环素24.52%)和低耐药率药物(环丙沙星6.92%、诺氟沙星14.10%),为指导临床治疗和公共卫生决策提供了关键证据。
original_quote: It is amply clear that long-term surveillance programmes are essential in the identification of changes in the epidemiology of V. cholerae and the monitoring of trends in antimicrobial resistance patterns of V. cholerae strains isolated in endemic localities. The drug susceptibility patterns of non-O1 strains should be particularly watched, as this has bearing on V. cholerae O1 isolates. It was shown that V. cholerae isolated after the epidemic of V. cholerae O139 had an expanding R type with resistance to a variety of drugs as compared to the O1 strains isolated before the advent of V. cholerae O139. Thus, a knowledge of seasonal distribution and antibiotic resistance pattern of V. cholerae isolates in particular geographical region would help in the delineation of appropriate measures required during epidemics. (Discussion-p.251)
effect_direction_original: 2-抑制AMR (通过监测指导合理用药)
spatial_context_original: 3-临床环境 (印度德里AIIMS医院急性水样腹泻患者)

title: Seasonality and antimicrobial resistance pattern of Vibrio cholerae in a tertiary care hospital of North India
pathogen: 印度德里地区霍乱弧菌(Vibrio cholerae)
amr_outcome_original: 霍乱治疗中抗生素的使用:虽然补液和电解质平衡恢复是霍乱治疗的本质,但抗生素作为支持性治疗常用于减少腹泻的量和持续时间(一旦呕吐停止); 10%-12%的霍乱病例密切家庭接触者可能细菌学阳性,建议进行化学预防,因他们可能发展为临床疾病; 在霍乱流行地区,识别霍乱弧菌耐药的抗生素非常重要,因耐药霍乱弧菌导致疾病持续时间更长,构成额外威胁; 多重耐药菌株通过患者粪便排泄进入环境(如水源),通过受污染水源传播给新的宿主,在季节性流行期间(夏季和季风季节)传播加剧
mechanism_chain_original: 霍乱患者感染霍乱弧菌 → 接受抗生素治疗(如四环素、氯霉素、呋喃唑酮、复方新诺明) → 抗生素对肠道霍乱弧菌产生选择压力 → 促进耐药菌株在患者肠道中富集 → 耐药菌株通过患者粪便排泄进入环境(如水源、污水系统) → 受污染水源(特别是在卫生条件较差的地区)成为霍乱弧菌传播的主要途径 → 季节性因素(夏季气温升高、季风季节降水增加)促进霍乱弧菌在受污染水源中生存、繁殖和传播 → 易感人群(如免疫力低下者、儿童)接触受污染水源感染耐药霍乱弧菌 → 耐药菌株在人群中传播和富集 → 10%-12%的霍乱病例密切家庭接触者可能细菌学阳性,建议进行化学预防(Introduction-p.249) → 化学预防进一步增加抗生素选择压力 → 促进耐药菌株传播 → 导致耐药霍乱弧菌构成额外威胁,疾病持续时间更长(Introduction-p.249)。本研究90.25%的菌株对至少一种抗生素耐药(Table 1),多重耐药菌株(对ACoFzNa耐药)在印度多个地区广泛传播(Discussion-p.250),提示耐药菌株通过人群流动、受污染水源等途径在地理上扩散。作者强调:"Though rehydration and restoration of electrolyte balance is the essence of cholera therapy, it does not diminish the degree of purging. Accordingly antibiotics have been commonly employed as supportive therapy to reduce the volume and duration of diarrhoea once vomiting has stopped. Additionally, 10%-12% of close household contacts of a cholera case may be bacteriologically positive - they are advised to undertake chemoprophylaxis as they may well develop clinical illness. Thus, in regions where cholera is endemic, it is important to identify those antibiotics to which V. cholerae is resistant since resistant V. cholerae poses an additional threat by leading to illness of a longer duration." (Introduction-p.249)。
original_quote: Though rehydration and restoration of electrolyte balance is the essence of cholera therapy, it does not diminish the degree of purging. Accordingly antibiotics have been commonly employed as supportive therapy to reduce the volume and duration of diarrhoea once vomiting has stopped. Additionally, 10%-12% of close household contacts of a cholera case may be bacteriologically positive - they are advised to undertake chemoprophylaxis as they may well develop clinical illness. Thus, in regions where cholera is endemic, it is important to identify those antibiotics to which V. cholerae is resistant since resistant V. cholerae poses an additional threat by leading to illness of a longer duration. (Introduction-p.249); "Cholera is endemic in Delhi with a seasonal distribution. Hundreds of laboratory-confirmed cases occur every year, peaking during the summer and monsoon seasons." (Introduction-p.249); "In the present study, a high rate of resistance to ampicillin, co-trimoxazole, furazolidone and nalidixic acid (ACoFzNa) was observed. Gastroenteritis due to V. cholerae O1 strains with a similar profile of resistance i.e. ACoFzNa have previously been reported in strains isolated from Bhillai, Ahmedabad, Allephey, Chennai (Madras), Vellore and Dibrugarh." (Discussion-p.250)

title: Determinants for antimicrobial resistance genes in farm dust on 333 poultry and pig farms in nine European countries
pathogen: 欧洲9国333个家禽和猪场农场粉尘细菌(携带ARGs)
amr_outcome_original: 农场粉尘是ARGs的大型储库,ARGs在几乎所有样本中可定量检测(>99%); 粉尘ARGs相对丰度与其他AMU暴露样本(如动物粪便或污水处理厂废水)相似; tetW和ermB绝对和相对丰度最高,aph(3')-III和sul2低约2-3个log10单位; 农场粉尘可能作为ARGs传播途径:1)动物和人类间传播ARB; 2)通过水平基因转移向其他储库细菌(包括潜在致病菌)传播ARGs
mechanism_chain_original: 动物粪便(含ARB和ARGs) → 通过气溶化(aerosolization)和颗粒物扩散进入农场环境 → 形成农场粉尘(粪便是主要来源但不是唯一来源,其他来源包括皮肤、黏液、饲料、垫料、室外空气或土壤) → 农场粉尘含有可活细菌、细菌DNA和ARGs(de Rooij et al., 2019; McEachran et al., 2015; Dohmen et al., 2017a; von Salviati et al., 2015; Laube et al., 2013; Liu et al., 2018) → 粉尘通过空气传播ARGs和ARB → 可能作为传播途径:1)农场内动物间传播ARB(Crombe et al., 2013); 2)暴露于农场空气的人(如农场工人)吸入含ARB的粉尘(Dohmen et al., 2017a; Bos et al., 2016); 3)粉尘沉降到农场附近环境(如土壤、水体),ARGs通过水平基因转移向其他储库细菌(包括潜在致病菌)传播(Huijbers et al., 2015, 2019; Scott et al., 2019)。农场粉尘ARGs相对丰度与其他AMU暴露样本(如动物粪便或污水处理厂废水)相似(Rodriguez-Mozaz et al., 2015; Discussion-p.6),提示农场粉尘是ARGs的重要储库。tetW和ermB(四环素和大环内酯耐药)绝对和相对丰度最高,aph(3')-III和sul2(氨基糖苷和磺胺耐药)低约2-3个log10单位(Fig. 1; Discussion-p.6)。
original_quote: Livestock feces with antimicrobial resistant bacteria reaches the farm floor, manure pit, farm land and wider environment by run off and aerosolization... Viable (resistant) bacteria, bacterial DNA and antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) are transported as part of dust particles through the air. (Introduction-p.2); "Most probably the role of farm dust in the epidemiology and ecology of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is complex and multilevel. On one hand it can act as a potential transmission route of resistant bacteria within and between animals and humans. On the other hand it is a potential reservoir of ARGs which might be transferred to bacteria, including potentially pathogenic bacteria in other reservoirs, by e.g. horizontal gene transfer." (Introduction-p.2); "Farm dust is a large reservoir of ARGs from which transmission to bacteria in other reservoirs can possibly occur." (Abstract); "Tetracycline (tetW) and macrolide (ermB) resistance genes were abundant in all samples both absolutely, and relatively to the total number of bacteria. The aminoglycoside (aph(3')-III) and sulfonamide (sul2) resistance genes were roughly 2–3 units lower on a log10 scale of absolute counts." (Discussion-p.6); "ARGs are omnipresent in dust... the relative levels of these genes are not very different from other (AMU exposed) samples such as animal feces or waste water from treatment plants. This could be explained by the fact that animal feces is very likely the most important source of dust through aerosolization of fecal particles." (Discussion-p.6); "Exposure to airborne AMR from farms will probably be more relevant for persons working in and around farms compared to the general population... While the general population is probably considerably lower exposed to airborne dust from farms, exposure to resistance genes frequently occurring in animal feces is however possible in the vicinity of farms. Transmission of ARGs and ARBs through air and dust between animals is most likely to occur as well." (Discussion-p.8)

title: Seasonal variations in antibiotic resistance genes in estuarine sediments and the driving mechanisms
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (夏季); 降水-增加 (夏季); 光照-增强 (夏季)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季河口沉积物ARGs种类增加76.9%-92.3%,丰度增加29-5195倍; 冬季ARGs种类增加5.9%-35.3%,丰度增加48-239倍; 不同河口ARGs丰度呈现不同季节性趋势(鳌江夏季>冬季; 瓯江和飞云江冬季>夏季)
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季(7月) → 沿岸工业城市(电镀厂、制革厂、养殖场、制药厂、化工厂等)大量运营 → 废水排放导致外源抗生素(最高355.2 μg/kg夏季瓯江, 325.69 μg/kg冬季瓯江)、重金属(最高629.09 mg/kg夏季瓯江, 580.27 mg/kg冬季瓯江)、有机污染物(PAHs、苯胺、硝基苯,最高0.536 μg/g夏季瓯江, 0.483 μg/g冬季瓯江)通过河流进入河口 → 夏季光照强度增强、光照时间延长、海水温度升高 → 促进污染物化学反应产生大量二次污染物 → 夏季降水增加导致洪水爆发 → 洪水携带大量污染物进入河流和河口 → 夏季沿海水域易发生赤潮 → 赤潮爆发释放大量有毒污染物 → 污染物沉降至河口沉积物 → 导致夏季河口沉积物化学污染物浓度(有机污染物、重金属、抗生素)显著高于冬季(与冬季相比,夏季瓯江河口有机污染物、重金属、抗生素分别增加0.053 μg/g, 48.82 mg/kg, 29.51 μg/kg; 鳌江分别增加0.042 μg/g, 36.93 mg/kg, 14.43 μg/kg; 飞云江分别增加0.044 μg/g, 37.89 mg/kg, 16.13 μg/kg) → 化学污染促进MGEs多样性和丰度(化学污染与MGEs数量和丰度正相关, Table 2) → MGEs丰度与ARG丰度显著正相关(p<0.01, r=0.884) → 化学污染通过水平基因转移(HGT)间接促进ARG丰度增加 → 导致夏季河口沉积物ARGs种类增加76.9%-92.3%,丰度增加29-5195倍(与对照SDS相比, Fig. 2); 冬季ARGs种类增加5.9%-35.3%,丰度增加48-239倍(与对照WDS相比, Fig. 2)。不同河口因污染物季节性排放和ARGs富集/衰减行为差异,ARGs丰度呈现不同季节性趋势:鳌江夏季>冬季(与河流污染物季节性排放一致); 瓯江和飞云江冬季>夏季(可能与ARGs富集/衰减行为有关, Discussion-p.7)。
original_quote: Under the effects of chemical pollutants (organic pollutants and heavy metals), the number and abundance of estuarine sediment ARGs significantly increased (Fig.2)... Compared with SDS and WDS, the number of different estuarine sediment ARGs increased by 76.9%–92.3% in summer and 5.9%–35.3% in winter, and the abundance of these ARGs increased by 29–5195 times in summer and 48–239 times in winter. (Results-p.5); "The abundance levels of sediment ARGs in the Oujiang and Feiyunjiang estuaries were higher in winter than in summer, while the abundance of sediment ARGs in the Aojiang estuary was approximately three orders of magnitude lower in winter than in summer (Fig.2)." (Results-p.5); "In the Oujiang estuary sediments, the concentrations of organic pollutants, heavy metals and antibiotics reached a maximum of 0.536 μg g−1, 629.09 mg kg-1 and 355.2 μg kg-1 in summer and 0.483 μg g−1, 580.27 mg kg-1 and 325.69 μg kg-1 in winter, respectively. Furthermore, the pollutant concentrations of estuarine sediments were higher in summer than in winter. Comparing summer with winter, the concentrations of organic pollutants, heavy metals and antibiotics increased by 0.053 μg g−1, 48.82 mg kg-1 and 29.51 μg kg-1 in the Oujiang estuary sediments, by 0.042 μg g−1, 36.93 mg kg-1 and 14.43 μg kg-1 in the Aojiang sediments, and by 0.044 μg g−1, 37.89 mg kg-1 and 16.13 μg kg-1 in the Feiyunjiang estuary sediments." (Results-p.5); "The difference in abiotic factors during summer and winter may be part of the reason for more pollutants in estuarine sediments during summer. The environmental conditions such as seasonal differences in sunlight and seawater temperature, as well as floods and red tides that are prone to bursting in summer, may cause an increase of pollutants in the estuary sediments, which subsequently influences the abundance of estuarine sediment ARGs. First of all, the sunlight intensity in the Wenzhou region is stronger in summer than in winter and the illumination time is also longer than in winter, which makes seawater temperatures higher in summer than in winter. This makes summer more favorable for the chemical reaction of pollutants in seawater and a large number of secondary pollutants are produced. Subsequently, this causes more contaminants to settle into sediments, thereby increasing contaminants in sediments. Furthermore, the precipitation in the Wenzhou region is greater in summer than in winter, which makes it easy to cause an outbreak of flooding in summer. The flood carries a large amount of pollutants into the river and then enters the estuary, thus increasing the pollutants in the estuary sediments. Last but not least, the coastal waters in the Wenzhou region are prone to red tides in summer, and a large number of toxic pollutants are released during the red tide outbreak. Some of these pollutants settle into sediments, thereby increasing pollutants in sediments." (Discussion-p.7); "Different estuaries displayed different seasonal trends in the abundance of sediment ARGs due to the seasonal nature of pollutant discharge from the estuarine river and the behaviors of estuarine sediment ARGs... This seasonal variation was closely correlated with the seasonal trend of ARG abundance in the Aojiang estuary sediment, indicating that the seasonal pollutant discharge from the Aojiang river was an important reason for the seasonal variation in ARG abundance in the Aojiang estuary sediment. However, the same data also shows that the seasonal variation in the pollutant concentrations in the waters of the Oujiang and Feiyunjiang rivers is not consistent with the seasonal trend of ARG abundance in the sediments of the Oujiang and Feiyunjiang estuaries, respectively. This result is most likely related to whether the estuarine sediment ARGs are being enriched or attenuated." (Discussion-p.7)

title: Seasonal variations in antibiotic resistance genes in estuarine sediments and the driving mechanisms
pathogen: 河口沉积物细菌(携带ARGs和MGEs)
amr_outcome_original: 化学污染与MGEs数量和丰度正相关(r=0.165和0.539, Table 2); MGEs丰度与ARG丰度显著正相关(p<0.01, r=0.884); 化学污染通过促进MGEs间接促进ARG丰度增加,促进细菌多重抗生素耐药性
mechanism_chain_original: 化学污染(重金属、有机污染物如PAHs、苯胺、硝基苯) → 对河口沉积物细菌产生选择压力 → 促进可移动遗传元件(MGEs)多样性和丰度增加(化学污染与MGEs数量和丰度正相关, r=0.165和0.539, Table 2) → MGEs(如质粒、转座子)携带ARGs → MGEs通过水平基因转移(HGT)在细菌间传播ARGs → MGEs丰度与ARG丰度显著正相关(p<0.01, r=0.884) → 化学污染通过促进MGEs间接促进ARG丰度增加 → 促进河口沉积物细菌多重抗生素耐药性。化学污染与ARGs多样性正相关(r=0.870抗生素, 0.883重金属, 0.891 PAHs, 0.886硝基苯, 0.899苯胺, Table 2),但与ARG丰度弱正相关(r=0.309, Table 2),提示化学污染直接影响ARGs多样性,但对ARG丰度的直接影响不显著,主要通过促进MGEs间接影响ARG丰度(Discussion-p.6-7)。
original_quote: We demonstrated that chemical pollution in the form of heavy metals, PAHs, nitrobenzene, and aniline, have selection effects on both diversity and abundance of ARGs in estuarine sediments... In this study, chemical pollution is significantly correlated with the number of different ARGs (Table 2), indicating that chemical pollution is a pivotal factor in promoting the diversity of estuarine sediment ARGs. However, chemical pollution and ARG abundance are only weakly positively correlated (Table 2), suggesting that the direct impact of chemical pollution on the abundance of estuarine sediment ARGs is not significant. (Discussion-p.6); "In addition, this study found that the abundance and number of different mobile genetic elements (MGEs) were positively correlated with chemical pollution levels (Table 2), indicating that chemical pollution promotes both abundance and diversity of estuarine sediment MGEs. Furthermore, MGE abundance is significantly positively correlated with ARG abundance (p < 0.01, r = 0.884). Therefore, chemical pollution indirectly affects ARG abundance by promoting MGEs. Previous studies have also shown that MGEs are closely linked to ARGs." (Discussion-p.6); "Overall, this study is a comprehensive analysis of the complex interactions between chemical pollutants (heavy metals and organic pollutants), MGEs, and ARGs in bacteria communities of estuarine sediments. The chemical pollution levels were correlated with the level of diversity of ARGs, but not the abundance of ARGs. This result, combined with the positive correlation between chemical pollution and MGEs, and the correlation between MGEs and the abundance of ARGs (Table 2) indicate that the ARGs are enriched in bacteria via horizontal gene transfer (HGT) triggered by chemical pollution in the estuarine sediment. Ultimately, these processes promote multi-antibiotic resistance in bacteria." (Discussion-p.7)

title: Seasonal variations in antibiotic resistance genes in estuarine sediments and the driving mechanisms
amr_outcome_original: 化学污染水平越高,ARGs多样性越高(瓯江>鳌江>飞云江); 夏季SOS检测到25种ARGs,其中19种在SDS中未检测到,提示这些ARGs由化学污染促进产生; 化学污染减少微生物多样性但增加ARGs多样性,促进多重耐药菌出现
mechanism_chain_original: 河流化学污染水平(瓯江>鳌江>飞云江, Tables S1-2) → 导致河口沉积物化学污染水平(瓯江>鳌江>飞云江, Tables S4-5) → 化学污染对细菌产生选择压力 → 促进携带ARGs的细菌存活和富集 → 化学污染促进ARGs在细菌间转移 → 导致化学污染水平越高,ARGs多样性越高。与鳌江和飞云江河口沉积物相比,冬季瓯江河口沉积物ARGs种类分别增加21.1%和27.8%(Fig. 2); 与飞云江河口沉积物相比,冬季鳌江河口沉积物ARGs种类增加5.6%(Fig. 2)。夏季呈现相似变化:与鳌江和飞云江河口沉积物相比,夏季瓯江河口沉积物ARGs种类分别增加8.7%和8.7%(Fig. 2)。夏季SOS检测到25种ARGs,其中19种在SDS中未检测到(Table S6),提示这些ARGs由化学污染促进产生。化学污染减少微生物多样性(Figs. S1-3)但增加ARGs多样性(Fig. 2),特别是化学污染最严重的夏季瓯江河口沉积物(SOS),ARGs种类约为SDS的2倍(Fig. 2),促进多重耐药菌出现。
original_quote: The number of different estuarine sediment ARGs was positively correlated with the chemical pollution levels of estuarine rivers... The diversity of ARGs in SOS was higher than those in SAS and SFS (Fig.2), because the chemical pollution level in the Oujiang river is more serious than levels in the Aojiang and Feiyunjiang rivers (Tables S1-2). ARG diversity in estuarine sediments increased as the estuarine contamination levels increased, which suggests that the more seriously chemically polluted estuary was more favorable for bacteria containing ARGs, and promoted the transfer of ARGs among bacteria. (Discussion-p.6); "The fact that chemical pollution levels of estuarine rivers were positively related to ARG diversity in estuary sediments, indicates that chemical pollution can contribute to the emergence of estuarine sediment ARGs. Some ARGs that were prevalent in estuarine sediments in summer, were not detected in the control sediments, suggesting that these ARGs were promoted by chemical pollution. For instance, a total of 25 different ARGs were detected in SOS, 19 of which were not found in SDS (Table S6), indicating that most of the ARGs in SOS were promoted by chemical pollution." (Discussion-p.6); "More multidrug-resistant bacteria are likely to emerge in seriously chemically polluted estuarine environments... This study found opposite trends between microbial communities and ARGs in the chemically polluted estuarine environment. Chemical pollution reduced the microbial diversity in estuarine sediments (Figs.S1-3), while the ARG diversity increased (Fig. 2). Especially in the most chemically polluted Oujiang estuary sediment in summer (SOS), the number of different ARGs was of approximately twice that of SDS (Fig. 2). Thus, the conditions favor the development of more multidrug resistant bacteria in the Oujiang estuary sediment." (Discussion-p.6)

title: Seasonal variations in antibiotic resistance genes in estuarine sediments and the driving mechanisms
amr_outcome_original: 抗生素失活(antibiotic deactivation)和外排泵(efflux pump)是河口沉积物主要耐药机制; 与对照相比,河口沉积物代表外排泵的ARGs种类在冬季减少9%-13%,代表细胞保护机制的ARGs种类在夏季减少6%-15%,代表抗生素失活机制的ARGs种类在夏季增加1%-6%、冬季增加11%-15%; 但这三类耐药机制ARGs丰度在夏季和冬季均显著增加(抗生素失活17-15348倍夏季、51-219倍冬季; 外排泵68-182倍夏季、33-2324倍冬季; 细胞保护40-1865倍夏季、18-543倍冬季)
mechanism_chain_original: 化学污染(重金属、有机污染物) → 对河口沉积物细菌产生选择压力 → 促进携带不同耐药机制ARGs的细菌存活和富集 → 通过MGEs和HGT在细菌间传播ARGs → 导致河口沉积物主要耐药机制为抗生素失活(antibiotic deactivation)和外排泵(efflux pump)(Fig. 4, Table S8)。与对照相比,河口沉积物代表外排泵的ARGs种类在冬季减少9%-13%,代表细胞保护机制的ARGs种类在夏季减少6%-15%,代表抗生素失活机制的ARGs种类在夏季增加1%-6%、冬季增加11%-15%(Fig. 4, Table S8)。但这三类耐药机制ARGs丰度在夏季和冬季均显著增加:抗生素失活(17-15348倍夏季、51-219倍冬季)、外排泵(68-182倍夏季、33-2324倍冬季)、细胞保护机制(40-1865倍夏季、18-543倍冬季)(Fig. 4, Table S9)。季节性变化对ARGs丰度的影响显著(夏季比冬季高138倍, Fig. 2),但对ARGs多样性的影响不显著(冬季23种 vs 夏季25种, Fig. 2),提示携带ARGs的细菌在河口沉积物中持续存在。
original_quote: The number and abundance of estuarine sediment ARGs representing distinct resistance mechanisms had different trends during summer and winter. Antibiotic deactivation and efflux pump were the main antibiotic resistance mechanisms in estuarine sediments (Fig.4, Table S8). Compared with the controls, the number of different estuarine sediment ARGs representing efflux pumps decreased by 9%–13% in winter. The number of different estuarine sediment ARGs representing cellular protection mechanisms declined by 6%–15% in summer. The number of different estuarine sediment ARGs representing antibiotic deactivation mechanisms increased by 1%–6% in summer and 11%–15% in winter. However, the abundance of estuarine sediment ARGs representing antibiotic deactivation, efflux pump, and cellular protection mechanisms significantly increased during summer and winter (Fig.4, Table S9). Compared with the controls, the abundance of these estuarine sediment ARGs increased by the following factors: antibiotic deactivation (17–15,348 times in summer, 51–219 times in winter), efflux pump (68–182 times in summer, 33–2324 times in winter), and cellular protection mechanisms (40–1865 times in summer, 18–543 times in winter). (Results-p.5-6); "Moreover, the total abundance of ARGs was impacted by seasonal changes (138-fold higher in summer than in winter, Fig. 2), but ARG diversity was not (e.g. 23 different ARGs in winter compared to 25 in summer, Fig. 2). This indicates that bacteria harboring the ARGs are persistent." (Discussion-p.7)

title: Seasonal variations in antibiotic resistance genes in estuarine sediments and the driving mechanisms
pathogen: 河口沉积物细菌(携带不同类型ARGs)
amr_outcome_original: 河口沉积物检测到51种ARGs,编码对6类抗生素耐药(氨基糖苷类、万古霉素、四环素、MLSB、FCA、β-内酰胺类); 与对照相比,河口沉积物ARGs种类增加:氨基糖苷类50%-200%(夏季和冬季)、FCA 0-50%(夏季)、MLSB 50%-300%(夏季)、0-250%(冬季)、β-内酰胺类0-50%(冬季)、四环素0-300%(夏季); ARGs丰度显著增加:氨基糖苷类12-50倍(夏季)、49-185倍(冬季)、万古霉素11-204倍(夏季)、17-171倍(冬季)、四环素14-69804倍(夏季)、33-373倍(冬季)、MLSB 102-208倍(夏季)、34-894倍(冬季)、FCA 53-192倍(夏季)、242-168056倍(冬季)、β-内酰胺类23-68582倍(夏季)、51-221倍(冬季)
mechanism_chain_original: 化学污染(重金属、有机污染物) → 对河口沉积物细菌产生选择压力 → 促进携带不同类型ARGs的细菌存活和富集 → 通过MGEs和HGT在细菌间传播ARGs → 导致河口沉积物检测到51种ARGs,编码对6类抗生素耐药(氨基糖苷类、万古霉素、四环素、MLSB、FCA、β-内酰胺类)(Fig. 3, Table S8)。与对照相比,河口沉积物ARGs种类增加:氨基糖苷类50%-200%(夏季和冬季)、FCA 0-50%(夏季)、MLSB 50%-300%(夏季)、0-250%(冬季)、β-内酰胺类0-50%(冬季)、四环素0-300%(夏季); 除万古霉素耐药基因外,其他类型ARGs种类均增加(Fig. 3, Table S8)。ARGs丰度显著增加:氨基糖苷类12-50倍(夏季)、49-185倍(冬季)、万古霉素11-204倍(夏季)、17-171倍(冬季)、四环素14-69804倍(夏季)、33-373倍(冬季)、MLSB 102-208倍(夏季)、34-894倍(冬季)、FCA 53-192倍(夏季)、242-168056倍(冬季)、β-内酰胺类23-68582倍(夏季)、51-221倍(冬季)(Fig. 2, Table S9)。河口沉积物ARGs组成与对照不同:夏季44种ARGs仅在河口沉积物中检测到,在SDS中未检测到; 冬季17种ARGs仅在河口沉积物中检测到,在WDS中未检测到(Results-p.6)。
original_quote: Compared with the controls, the number and abundance of detected ARGs in estuarine sediments greatly increased during summer and winter. Fifty-one different ARGs were detected in estuarine sediments, while only 25 different ARGs were found in the control sediments (Tables S6-7). Of the ARGs detected, six types coded for different antibiotic resistances (Fig.3, Table S8). Compared with the controls, the number of different estuarine sediment ARGs increased, except for vancomycin resistance genes. These numbers of different resistance genes increased by the following percentages: aminoglycoside (50%–200% in summer and winter), fluoroquinolone quinolone florfenicol chloramphenicol amphenicol (FCA) (0–50% in summer), macrolide-lincosamide-streptogramin B (MLSB) (50%–300% in summer, 0–250% in winter), β-lactam (0–50% in winter), and tetracycline (0–300% in summer). Similarly, the abundance of estuarine sediment ARGs markedly increased (Fig.2, Table S9). Compared with the controls, the abundance of resistance genes in estuarine sediments increased by the following factors: aminoglycoside (12–50 times in summer, 49–185 times in winter), vancomycin (11–204 times in summer, 17–171 times in winter), tetracycline (14–69,804 times in summer, 33–373 times in winter), MLSB (102–208 times in summer, 34–894 times in winter), FCA (53–192 times in summer, 242–168,056 times in winter), and β-lactam (23–68,582 times in summer, 51–221 times in winter). (Results-p.5-6); "Compared with the controls, the occurrence of ARGs in estuarine sediments changed greatly during summer and winter. Totals of 44 and 17 different ARGs were detected only in estuarine sediments in summer and winter, respectively, i.e., they were not found in the controls (SDS and WDS)... Therefore, the composition of estuarine sediment ARGs was different from that of the controls during summer and winter." (Results-p.6)

climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (夏季6-8月,度假旺季); 温度-降低 (冬春季2-3月)
pathogen: 湖泊异养细菌(嗜温菌,携带质粒)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季疗养院区多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)从1996年48%增至1999年96%; 中央区从25%增至50%; 冬春季多重耐药菌显著下降,主要为单一耐药(对氨苄西林耐药,10-40%)
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季(6-8月)度假旺季 → 疗养院大量运营 → 废水排放导致人类废弃物中的外源多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)大量进入湖泊 → 温度升高(25°C)促进外源嗜温菌和内源性细菌生长和繁殖 → 增强质粒水平基因转移频率 → 导致疗养院区(Station 7)多重耐药菌从1996年48%增至1999年96%(Fig. 1),中央区(Station 3)从25%增至50%(Fig. 1)。多重耐药菌随距离疗养院距离增加而减少(Fig. 2)。冬春季(2-3月)温度降低(5°C) → 疗养院停止运营 → 废水排放大幅减少 → 嗜温菌生长受抑制,主要为耐冷菌(psychrotolerant)和不可培养菌(non-culturable) → 多重耐药菌显著下降,主要为单一耐药(对氨苄西林耐药,10-40%,Fig. 3)。
original_quote: From the data presented in Figure 1, it is apparent that during the peak of the resort season the original antibiotic sensitive bacteria tended to be replaced by multiple resistance bacteria... In the resort part of the lake, from about 15% to between 1 and 2%, we observed a concurrent increase of multiple resistance of bacteria to antibiotics from 48% to 96% (Figure 1). In the central part of the lake (about 2 km from the coast) the % of heterotrophic bacteria with multiple antibiotic resistance in July from ca. 25 to 50%. (Results-p.2); "From the data presented in Figure 2, it is apparent that isolates with multiple resistance were found to decrease with the distance from the resort." (Results-p.2); "A decline in the bacterial numbers with multiple antibiotic resistance was observed during the cold period (February–March)." (Abstract); "In the winter-spring period only two types of bacteria were isolated from the water samples: psychrotolerant (the growth frontiers range from −5 °C up to +30 °C); inducible mesophilic bacteria (the growth frontiers range from +10 °C up to +30 °C). Among these physiological groups 10 to 40% of the isolates exhibited ampicillin resistance (Figure 3)." (Results-p.3); "Multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotroph bacteria can be induced both by natural and anthropogenic factors (Figures 1 and 2). These factors were observed to increase antibiotic-resistant bacterial cells in the central part of the lake from June (at the depth of 10 and 20 m) till November (at the depths of 0.1 and 10 m, Figure 3). Low percentage of antibiotic-resistant cells found in spring at the depths of 10 and 20 m can indicate that natural factors had no effects on the generation of antibiotic resistance. However, during this period in the group of psychrotolerant bacteria the quantity of resistant cells at the depth of 0.1 m increased which can be due to the human impact (resort drainages). These bacteria are the ones that are responsible for the high percentage of heterotrophs in lake microflora. In the summer period mesophilic forms presented the most part of cells." (Discussion-p.5)

title: Geographical and seasonal distribution of multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria of Lake Shira
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (夏季6-8月); 盐度-变化
pathogen: 湖泊异养细菌(嗜温菌,携带质粒)
amr_outcome_original: 疗养院区和中央区分离的质粒大小相似(如5.6 kb和11.5 kb),提示质粒水平基因转移; 携带质粒的细菌多为多重耐药菌; 疗养院区分离的细菌携带1-4个质粒,中央区携带不超过2个质粒
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季外源多重抗生素耐药菌(携带质粒,如4.4 kb质粒类似pBR322,编码对β-内酰胺类和大环内酯类抗生素耐药)通过疗养院废水排放进入湖泊 → 温度升高(25°C)促进外源菌和内源性细菌生长和繁殖 → 增强质粒水平基因转移频率 → 外源菌携带的质粒(如5.6 kb和11.5 kb)通过水平基因转移(horizontal gene transfer)转移至内源性细菌 → 导致疗养院区(Station 7)和中央区(Station 3)分离的质粒大小相似(Table 1: Stations 7和3均检测到5.6 kb和11.5 kb质粒),提示质粒在外源菌和内源性细菌间转移。疗养院区分离的细菌携带1-4个质粒(如isolates 43, 106, 116, 118, 125),中央区携带不超过2个质粒(如isolates 9, 10, 14, 18),提示疗养院区质粒负荷更高。外源菌也可从内源性细菌接收质粒,获得新特征(如对渗透压的耐受性)。
original_quote: Extra-chromosomal genetic elements of the bacterial cells may be the reason for the resistance to different antibiotics. Some bacterial isolates from Shira lake that exhibited multiple antibiotic resistance carried plasmids of different molecular weight. In most plasmid-bearing cells isolated in the resort area of Shira lake, one to four plasmids of different weights were obtained. In the central part of the lake, we also found plasmid-bearing bacteria with no more than two plasmids. Some plasmids (5.6 kb and 11.5 kb) were found in bacterial isolates from the central and resort parts of the lake. However, some plasmids were found only in bacterial cells isolated from the central part of the lake (Table 1). (Results-p.3-4); "Bacterial isolates taken from the part of the lake with the highest anthropogenic loads (Station 7) exhibited the highest number of plasmids. Some isolates exhibiting multiple antibiotic resistance were found to contain plasmids of 4.4 kb. This is similar to the size of pBR322 plasmid (4.4 kb) displaying resistance to two antibiotic classes (β-lactames and macrolides)." (Discussion-p.4); "Plasmids of similar size found in the cells of bacterial isolates from the resort and central part of the lake can be the result of extrachromosomal DNA transfer among the heterotrophic microflora (Table 1). To reveal adaptive mechanisms of bacteria to conditions of specific ecosystems must be taken into account of the transfer of plasmids from autochthonous to allochthonous microorganisms and vice versa. By such an exchange the autochthonous bacteria can receive plasmids from the allochthonous bacteria. In addition, the allochthonous bacteria can also receive plasmid DNAs from the autochthonous bacteria and acquire new characters by this (e.g., resistance to osmotic pressure)." (Discussion-p.4-5); "Plasmid determinants released into the lake during the season by the allochthonous microflora can promote the migration of plasmid DNAs to autochthonous bacteria." (Discussion-p.5)

title: Geographical and seasonal distribution of multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria of Lake Shira
pathogen: 湖泊异养细菌(耐盐菌,携带2.7 kb质粒)
amr_outcome_original: 耐盐菌(halotolerant bacteria,耐受5-10% NaCl)表现出多重抗生素耐药性但不携带质粒; 嗜盐菌(halophile bacteria,耐受0.05-5% NaCl)携带2.7 kb质粒,其拷贝数随NaCl浓度升高而增加(0.05%时低,5%时加倍,10%时增加较少)
mechanism_chain_original: 中央区(Station 3)耐盐菌(halotolerant bacteria,耐受5-10% NaCl)表现出多重抗生素耐药性但不携带质粒(如isolate 239,Table 1) → 提示多重抗生素耐药性可能由染色体决定因子或大型质粒(未被检测方法检测到)编码。中央区嗜盐菌(halophile bacteria,耐受0.05-5% NaCl)携带2.7 kb质粒,其拷贝数随NaCl浓度升高而增加(0.05%时低,5%时加倍,10%时增加较少,Fig. 6) → 提示2.7 kb质粒对淡水微生物在咸水Shira湖中生存具有重要作用,可能帮助细菌适应高渗透压环境。耐盐菌细胞壁更致密,细胞膜组成特殊(含减少渗透性和增强对环境因子耐受性的蛋白质),使其对抗生素耐药。疗养院区(Station 7)淡水菌(20-40%)和嗜盐菌(55-75%)占主导,耐盐菌很少; 中央区耐盐菌(25-30%)和嗜盐菌(47-66%)占主导(Fig. 4)。
original_quote: From the data presented in Figure 4 it is also obvious that in the central part of the lake the heterotrophic bacteria are represented by halotolerant (25–30%) and halophile (47–66%) forms, while in the resort area freshwater (20–40%) and halophile (55–75%) bacteria were dominant. In the resort part of the lake, the halotolerant bacteria were negligible. When antibiotic resistance was determined in freshwater, halophile and halotolerant bacteria, the halotolerant bacteria exhibited antibiotic resistance but were plasmid-free (Figure 5). One example of such a bacterium that was free of plasmids was the isolate 239 (Table 1) exhibiting multiple antibiotic resistance. (Results-p.3-4); "Nevertheless, some halophile bacteria isolated from the central part of Shira lake were found to have a plasmid of 2.7 kb. Their copy numbers in the cells varied with the sodium chloride concentration of the medium (Figure 6). The electrophoretic data showed that in low NaCl medium (0.05%) the copy number of this plasmid is low. However, the copy number of plasmids increases with salt concentration from 0.05 to 10%. In the cells of Micrococcus sp. (isolate 9, Figure 6) the copy number of this plasmid increased particularly at a salt concentration of 5% (more than double), while an increase to 10% NaCl resulted in less pronounced increase of the plasmid concentration (Figure 6). This allows suggesting that the plasmid of 2.7 kb is of primary importance for survival of freshwater microorganisms in the brackish Shira lake." (Results-p.4); "A much more dense cell wall accompanied the increase of resistance of halotolerant bacteria. It may be this feature (special composition of the membrane and density of the cell wall) that makes halotolerant bacteria resistant to antibiotics. It is common knowledge that the composition of the cell membrane of halotolerant bacteria involves proteins that reduce permeability and increase tolerance of bacteria to various environmental factors." (Discussion-p.4)
effect_direction_original: 1-促进AMR (耐盐菌通过致密细胞壁耐药); 1-适应环境 (嗜盐菌通过2.7 kb质粒适应高盐)

pathogen: 湖泊异养细菌(嗜温菌 vs 耐冷菌 vs 不可培养菌)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季嗜温菌(mesophilic bacteria,生长温度范围+10°C至+30°C)占主导,多重抗生素耐药性明显(从6月开始至11月); 冬春季耐冷菌(psychrotolerant bacteria,生长温度范围−5°C至+30°C)和不可培养菌(non-culturable bacteria,需温度诱导和营养物添加后才可培养)占主导,主要为单一耐药(对氨苄西林耐药,10-40%)
mechanism_chain_original: 冬春季(2-3月)温度低(5°C) → 不可培养菌(non-culturable bacteria)占主导,活跃但不可培养 → 经温度诱导(45°C, 10分钟)和营养物添加(peptone)后总异养细菌数量增加两个数量级 → 耐冷菌(psychrotolerant bacteria)可在低温下生长(-5°C至+30°C) → 这两类生理群体中10-40%表现出对氨苄西林单一耐药(Fig. 3),多重耐药菌很少。夏季(6-8月)温度升高(25°C) → 嗜温菌(mesophilic bacteria,生长温度范围+10°C至+30°C)数量显著增加 → 嗜温菌中多重抗生素耐药性明显(从6月开始至11月,Fig. 3) → 10米深度耐盐菌中多重耐药菌占主导。
original_quote: Since the temperature of the lake varies with the depth and season, we have analyzed different physiological groups of bacteria with respect to growth optima (psychrotolerant, mesophiles). In natural ecosystems, culturable cells do not exceed 0.1%. Therefore, the bacterial cells were analyzed after induction by temperature increase and nutrient additions (peptone). The total number of the heterotrophic bacteria increased two orders of magnitude after heating (45 °C) of water samples during 10 min. (Results-p.2-3); "From the data presented in Figure 3, it is apparent that multiple resistance to antibiotics is typical for the mesophilic bacteria. This resistance appears at the start of the resort season (June) and remains until November. In the winter-spring period only two types of bacteria were isolated from the water samples: psychrotolerant (the growth frontiers range from −5 °C up to +30 °C); inducible mesophilic bacteria (the growth frontiers range from +10 °C up to +30 °C). Among these physiological groups 10 to 40% of the isolates exhibited ampicillin resistance (Figure 3)." (Results-p.3); "In the summer period mesophilic forms presented the most part of cells. Halotolerant bacteria with multiple antibiotic resistance dominated at a depth of 10 m. Microorganisms of psychrotolerant and non-culturable group exhibited similar resistance to one or two antibiotics tested, irrespective of the layer where they had been taken from (Figure 3). Multiple antibiotic resistance was obtained among dominant mesophilic bacteria in the lake in the summer period." (Discussion-p.5)
effect_direction_original: 1-促进AMR (夏季嗜温菌); 2-抑制AMR (冬春季耐冷菌和不可培养菌)

title: Multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria in the littoral zone of Lake Shira as an indicator of human impact on the ecosystem
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (夏季,度假旺季); 降水-变化 (春季融雪径流)
pathogen: 湖泊近岸带异养细菌(Aeromonas, Citrobacter, Vibrio, E. coli, Enterococcus, Sarcina等)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季近岸带和中央区多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)占主导地位,未检测到敏感菌; 春季敏感菌和仅对氨苄西林耐药菌占主导地位,多重耐药菌浓度显著降低
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季(6-8月)度假旺季 → 疗养院和旅游营地大量运营 → 废水排放(未经处理或处理不当)和人类及动物粪便冲刷进入湖泊 → 外源多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)通过废水和粪便输入湖泊 → 外源菌首先在近岸带浅水区积累,然后通过水体混合和表层水输送扩散至中央区 → 导致夏季近岸带和中央区多重耐药菌占主导地位(近岸带各站点如1, 2, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18未检测到敏感菌; 中央区Station 21多重耐药菌浓度与近岸区Station 16相似)。春季(3月)人类活动减少 → 疗养院停止运营 → 废水排放大幅减少 → 但融雪径流仍可携带粪便中的外源菌(如Enterococcus, Sarcina)进入湖泊 → 导致春季敏感菌和仅对氨苄西林耐药菌(内源性特征)占主导地位,多重耐药菌浓度显著降低,主要集中在接收废水排放的区域(Station 19)、疗养院区域(Station 18)和旅游营地区域(Station 13),以及无法到达的区域(Stations 3, 5)和中央区(Station 21)也检测到少量多重耐药菌(外源性)。
original_quote: It has been found that in Summer, human and animal microflora featuring multiple antibiotic resistance (to Ampicillin and Kanamycin) predominates in all the studied stations of the littoral zone of the lake. In Spring, concentrations of bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance decrease significantly and bacteria sensitive to antibiotics predominate in the lake. Emergence of multiple antibiotic resistance in bacteria of Lake Shira is caused by the input of allochthonous bacteria into the lake; this feature of heterotrophic bacteria of Lake Shira can be used to monitor the impact on the ecosystem made by health resorts. (Abstract); "We examined bacteria isolated from samples collected at different stations of the littoral zone in Summer and did not find any bacteria sensitive to antibiotics even at stations situated far from the close-to-resort part. Concentrations of bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance registered at Stations 3–7, which are infrequently visited by vacationers, and at Stations 8–12, which are inaccessible to vacationers, were comparable to concentrations of such bacteria at Stations 1, 2, 13 and 14, which are situated near the tourist camps, and at Station 16, situated near the resorts. In the central part of Lake Shira (Station 21), the levels of bacteria displaying multiple antibiotic resistance were similar to those registered in the close-to-resort zone (Station 16). High concentrations of bacteria resistant to Ampicillin and Kanamycin in the parts of the littoral zone that are either not frequented by vacationers or are inaccessible to them and in the central part of Lake Shira can probably be a result of transport of such bacteria with the water from the parts of the lake that suffer most from human impact." (Discussion-p.4); "In Spring, when anthropogenic input is very small, bacteria sensitive to antibiotics and bacteria only resistant to Ampicillin predominated in the littoral zone of the lake. Bacteria displaying multiple antibiotic resistance were mainly isolated from the part of the lake receiving resort waste effluents (Station 19), the resort part (Station 18) and the area where tourist camps are situated (Station 13). The bacteria resistant to Ampicillin and Kanamycin that were isolated from samples collected at Station 19 were of Enterococcus and Sarcina spp. and at Stations 13 and 18 – of Enterococcus sp. The water samples collected from the littoral part of Lake Shira that is inaccessible to tourists (Stations 3 and 5) and from the central part of the lake contained bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance." (Results-p.3); "The main reason why Enterococcus and Sarcina spp. occur in the lake in Spring, when human impact on the ecosystem is very low, may be that these bacteria, contained in vertebrates' feces, enter the lake with snowmelt runoff." (Discussion-p.6)

title: Multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria in the littoral zone of Lake Shira as an indicator of human impact on the ecosystem
pathogen: 湖泊近岸带和中央区异养细菌(内源性细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季外源多重耐药菌可能通过水平基因转移将抗生素耐药基因转移至内源性细菌,导致内源性细菌获得多重抗生素耐药性
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季外源多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)大量进入湖泊 → 在近岸带和中央区积累 → 外源菌与内源性细菌接触 → 通过水平基因转移(horizontal gene transfer)将抗生素耐药基因从外源菌转移至内源性细菌 → 导致内源性细菌获得多重抗生素耐药性作为稳定特征 → 这一过程可能导致内源性细菌群落结构发生显著变化,影响生态系统功能。春季外源菌输入减少后,仍在近岸带无法到达的区域(Stations 3, 5)和中央区(Station 21)检测到多重耐药菌,提示可能有内源性细菌通过水平基因转移获得了多重抗生素耐药性,或外源菌残留。
original_quote: The occurrence of heterotrophic bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance in the lake in Spring 2003 suggested that either those bacteria were allochthonous or antibiotic resistance in autochthonous bacteria became a stable trait as a result of horizontal gene transfer from allochthonous bacteria in Summer. (Discussion-p.5); "One of the possible reasons causing structural changes in the bacterial component of the ecosystem is horizontal transfer of antibiotic resistance genes from allochthonous bacteria to autochthonous bacteria, which can thus acquire the new traits." (Conclusion-p.7)

title: Multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria in the littoral zone of Lake Shira as an indicator of human impact on the ecosystem
climate_factor_original: 温度-变化 (季节性); 降水-变化 (春季融雪径流)
pathogen: 湖泊近岸带和中央区异养细菌(外源性细菌和内源性细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季外源多重耐药菌可通过附着沉积物颗粒在近岸带存活,形成耐药菌库,冬春季可重新悬浮至水体,导致湖泊持续污染
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季外源多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)进入近岸带浅水区 → 细菌通过附着沉积物颗粒在近岸带底部存活 → 形成耐药菌库(reservoir) → 冬春季沉积物扰动或水动力变化 → 耐药菌从沉积物重新悬浮至水体 → 导致湖泊持续污染,即使春季人类活动显著减少,仍可能检测到外源多重耐药菌。沉积物中的指示微生物(如E. coli, enterococci, fecal coliforms)降解速率低于水体,底部沉积物可作为延长指示微生物存活的储库,增加了因潜在固体再悬浮导致上覆水体重新污染的风险。
original_quote: Contamination of the littoral part of the lake with allochthonous bacteria is potentially dangerous to the ecosystem because this is the zone where bacteria can survive by attaching themselves to sediment particles. An et al. (2001), conducted their studies at Lake Texoma and found that concentrations of E. coli and total coliforms increased with depth and their maximal concentrations were registered in water samples collected from the bottom layer of water, because bacteria were associated with lake-bottom sediments. Comparison of reduction rates of microbial indicators (E. coli, enterococci, fecal coliforms) in the water and sediment of a brackish water body (Lake Pontchartrain) also showed that the reduction rate of indicator organisms in sediment was slower. The authors assumed that the reason was attachment of microbial indicators to sediment. Thus, bottom sediment may act as a reservoir for prolonging indicator organism survival, which adds concern of recontamination of overlaying waters due to potential solids resuspension. (Discussion-p.6,引用An et al., 2001; Jin et al., 2004)

title: Multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria in the littoral zone of Lake Shira as an indicator of human impact on the ecosystem
pathogen: 湖泊近岸带和中央区异养细菌(外源性细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 夏季外源多重耐药菌从近岸带通过表层水输送至中央区,导致中央区多重耐药菌浓度与近岸区相似
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季外源多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)在近岸带积累 → 通过表层水混合和输送 → 外源菌从近岸带高风险区域(如疗养院和旅游营地附近)向低风险区域(如中央区)扩散 → 导致中央区(Station 21)多重耐药菌浓度与近岸区(Station 16)相似。春季外源菌输入减少,中央区多重耐药菌浓度显著降低,但仍检测到少量外源菌(如Enterococcus),提示表层水输送的持续性影响。分类学分析显示近岸区和中央区的外源多重耐药菌种类相似(如C. freundii, E. coli),进一步支持表层水输送机制。
original_quote: High concentrations of bacteria resistant to Ampicillin and Kanamycin in the parts of the littoral zone that are either not frequented by vacationers or are inaccessible to them and in the central part of Lake Shira can probably be a result of transport of such bacteria with the water from the parts of the lake that suffer most from human impact. (Discussion-p.4); "In the central part of Lake Shira (Station 21), the levels of bacteria displaying multiple antibiotic resistance were similar to those registered in the close-to-resort zone (Station 16)... The emergence of multiple antibiotic resistance in the heterotrophic bacteria found in the part of the lake least affected by the anthropogenic input can be accounted for by the transport of allochthonous bacteria from the parts of the lake subjected to a considerable human impact." (Results-p.2); "For instance, similar amounts of bacteria of Aeromonas sp. were isolated from the samples collected at Station 15 (at the tourist camp) and Station 18 (in the close-to-resort area) and from water samples collected at Station 10, which is not frequented by vacationers. The levels of C. freundii in the close-to-resort area (Station 16) and in the area near tourist camps (Station 1) were similar to the levels of this bacterium in the central part of Lake Shira... E. coli, another allochthonous bacterium, was found not only in the close-to-resort area but also in the central part of the lake and at Station 3, which is inaccessible to vacationers. E. coli apparently enters the lake with untreated waste effluents of the health resort." (Discussion-p.4-5)

title: Multiple antibiotic resistance of heterotrophic bacteria in the littoral zone of Lake Shira as an indicator of human impact on the ecosystem
pathogen: 湖泊近岸带和中央区异养细菌(外源性细菌和内源性细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 多重抗生素耐药性(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)可作为人类活动对Shira湖生态系统影响的指示指标,用于监测疗养院的环境影响
mechanism_chain_original: 夏季多重抗生素耐药菌(对氨苄西林和卡那霉素耐药)在近岸带占主导地位 → 表层水输送导致中央区多重耐药菌浓度升高 → 春季人类活动减少,多重耐药菌浓度显著降低,敏感菌和仅对氨苄西林耐药菌(内源性特征)占主导地位 → 多重抗生素耐药性的季节性变化模式反映人类活动强度 → 通过比较不同季节(夏季度假旺季 vs 春季/冬季)中央区多重耐药菌浓度,可评估疗养院对生态系统的影响程度 → 中央区作为对照点(远离疗养院,受人类活动影响最小),其多重耐药菌浓度变化可作为人类活动影响的指示指标。近岸带Stations 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 16, 18, 19应作为重点监测区域,因为这些区域多重耐药菌浓度较高,反映强人类活动影响。
original_quote: We should note that our suggestion of using multiple antibiotic resistance of bacteria in monitoring human impact on Lake Shira is well grounded. For instance, seasonal variations in proportions of littoral-water bacteria resistant to Ampicillin and Kanamycin are a good indicator of the degree to which humans affect the study aquatic ecosystem (Fig. 5). The diagram shows that in Summer, bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance predominate in the littoral zone of the lake and the portion of bacteria only resistant to Ampicillin is very small. In Spring, bacteria sensitive to antibiotics and bacteria resistant to Ampicillin predominate in the littoral zone. (Discussion-p.5); "One of the approaches to monitoring the human impact on Lake Shira is to measure the proportion of bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance in the central part of the lake in different seasons and to use these data as an indication of human impact. As this part is far away from the health resorts and, hence, least of all affected by human impact, it can be used as control in monitoring the ecosystem. Human impact on the lake can be assessed by comparing the concentrations of bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance in Summer, when there are many vacationers at the lake, and in cold seasons, when the anthropogenic input is very low." (Conclusion-p.7); "Having analyzed the distribution of bacteria featuring multiple antibiotic resistance in the littoral zone of the lake in different seasons, we can note that most of the bacteria resistant to Ampicillin and Kanamycin were isolated from the samples collected at Stations 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 16, 18 and 19. Hence, these stations can be characterized as areas subjected to strong human impact and should be monitored closely." (Discussion-p.6)
