title: Antibiotic resistant genes profile in the surface water of subtropical drinking water river-reservoir system
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (湿季32°C vs 干季19°C)
pathogen: 表层水微生物(携带ARGs的细菌, 特别是Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes, Actinobacteria)
mechanism_chain_original: 湿季水温较高(32°C) vs 干季水温较低(19°C) → 高温促进细菌生长速率 → 促进携带ARGs细菌的富集和繁殖速率 → 高温有利于ARGs的交换或游离遗传物质的吸收,促进ARGs水平转移 → 导致湿季ARG总相对丰度(1.23×10^-2 - 1.71×10^-2)显著高于干季(1.00×10^-2 - 1.26×10^-2, P=0.018)。One-way ANOVA和ANOSIM分析证实季节性变化对ARG相对丰度的影响显著大于空间变化(R=0.68, P<0.01)。SEM分析显示水温对ARG相对丰度有显著正向影响(标准化回归权重=1.447, P<0.05)。
original_quote: In this study, although the average difference of water temperature between dry season and wet season was only 10 °C, there was the significant difference between both season in term of ARGs total relative abundance. This result meant that seasonal variation could affect ARGs abundance in the surface water of subtropical drinking water river-reservoir system, even if water temperature would not vary as dramatically as in temperate and cold regions. (Discussion-p.6); "The phenomenon of increasing local temperature associating with increasing antibiotic resistance also been found in this study. The reason could be attributed to the following processes: Firstly, the higher temperature is conducive to the exchange of ARGs or the absorption of free genetic material, and thereby promote the horizontal transfer of ARGs; Secondly, the higher temperature is one of the most powerful regulatory factor of bacterial growth rate, which can lead to the enrichment and propagation rate of ARBs." (Discussion-p.6); "As shown in Fig. 6-A, with the exception of the R3 river, the total relative abundances of ARGs in others rivers and reservoir during wet season (1.23 × 10^-2 - 1.71 × 10^-2) exceeded those observed in dry season (1.00 × 10^-2 - 1.26 × 10^-2). One-way ANOVA result confirmed the difference between dry season group and wet season group reached the level of statistical significance (P = 0.018). Additionally, ANOSIM analysis result based on various individual ARG abundance revealed the significant heterogeneity of ARGs abundance between dry season group and wet season group (R = 0.68, P < 0.01), suggesting that seasonal variation exert a more profound influence on ARG relative abundance than geographical variations." (Results-p.4); "SEM analysis result (Fig. 7) showed that ammonia nitrogen concentration, TOC concentration, water temperature and pH level were the significant direct influence factors on the ARGs abundance (P < 0.05)... Standardized regression weights of ammonia nitrogen concentration, TOC concentration, water temperature and pH level were 0.700, 1.414, 1.447 and 1.727, respectively." (Results-p.4)

title: Antibiotic resistant genes profile in the surface water of subtropical drinking water river-reservoir system
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (湿季32°C vs 干季19°C)
pathogen: 表层水微生物(携带ARGs的细菌, 特别是Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes, Actinobacteria)
amr_outcome_original: 湿季主导ARG(adeF)通过水平基因转移在优势宿主菌(Proteobacteria)中广泛传播; 干季主导ARG(TEM-116)通过内源性抗生素合成途径(青霉素和头孢菌素合成)产生
mechanism_chain_original: 湿季高温(32°C) → 促进细菌间ARGs交换或游离遗传物质吸收 → 促进ARGs水平基因转移(HGT) → 主导ARG(adeF, 喹诺酮类耐药基因)在优势宿主菌(Proteobacteria)中广泛传播(相对丰度3.42×10^-4 - 3.87×10^-3),adeF在湿季占比17%-23%,占据最高比例。干季特异性抗生素合成途径(青霉素和头孢菌素合成, 蓝色标签, Fig. 8) → 影响β-内酰胺酶耐药性 → 主导ARG(TEM-116, β-内酰胺酶耐药基因)在干季显著富集(相对丰度2.14×10^-4 - 1.89×10^-3),但在湿季未检测到,TEM-116在干季R1和R3河流中占比19%和10%。湿季特异性抗生素合成途径(紫绀蓝素合成, 紫色标签, Fig. 8) → 影响喹诺酮类耐药性 → adeF作为湿季主导ARG与该途径一致。
original_quote: Antibiotic-resistant genes demonstrated obvious enrichment in the drinking water river-reservoir system... Therefore, interspecific and intraspecific horizontal gene transfer may serve as the principal driving mechanisms, and this hypothesis could be supported by the observed ARB community structure... In this study, metagenomic assembly-based host-tracking analysis revealed the obvious higher ARBs proportions in Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes and Actinobacteria compared to other phyla. These species as the typical bacterial communities in natural aquatic environment implied that ARGs in drinking water river-reservoir system have the higher potential amplification capacity by horizontal gene transfer. Indeed, the dominated ARBs in the different samples showed the similar variation tendency with dominated ARGs in this study. (Discussion-p.5); "In addition, attention should also be directed towards the role of antibiotic biosynthesis in modulating innate microbial resistance. As shown in Fig. 8, although biosynthesis pathways for macrolides and tetracyclines were absent in the system, Pyocyanine biosynthesis (purple label) and Penicillin and Cephalosporin biosynthesis (blue label) that affect quinolones resistance and β-lactamases were found to be the specific pathways in wet season group and dry season group, respectively. Meanwhile, the corresponding β-lactamases ARG (TEM-116) and quinolone ARG (adeF) as the dominated ARG in the both groups showed the similar existing characteristics. Above findings revealed the influence of bacterial endogenous resistance on the formation of dominated ARGs and confirmed that the ARGs distribution pattern in the target system may be attributed to autologous evolution." (Discussion-p.5); "As shown in Fig. 2-B, the results indicated that the similarity of dominated ARGs in wet season was higher than those in dry season. In wet season, except for ErmG was the dominated gene in R1 river (10%), adeF occupied the highest proportion in R2-R5 rivers and reservoir (17%–23%). In dry season, TEM-116 dominated the ARG profile in R1 (19%) and R3 (10%) rivers." (Results-p.3)

title: Antibiotic resistant genes profile in the surface water of subtropical drinking water river-reservoir system
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高 (湿季32°C vs 干季19°C)
pathogen: 表层水微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 湿季主导耐药机制为抗生素外排(45%-60%),干季主导耐药机制为抗生素失活(37%-52%)
mechanism_chain_original: 湿季水温较高(32°C) → 增强微生物群体感应信号(quorum sensing signals) → 促进外排泵基因转移 → 导致湿季主导耐药机制为抗生素外排(45%-60%),次要机制为靶标改变(22%)和抗生素失活(29%)。干季水温较低(19°C) → 微生物群体感应信号减弱 → 外排泵系统比例降低 → 导致干季主导耐药机制为抗生素失活(37%-52%),次要机制为抗生素外排(33%-44%)和靶标改变(21%-43%)。TOC浓度对抗生素外排机制比例有显著负相关(R=-0.90, P<0.01),因为低TOC浓度下外排泵过表达会增加微生物抗生素耐药性的适应度成本(fitness cost),不利于微生物存活和富集。
original_quote: Antibiotic resistance mechanism generally showed the obvious difference between wet season and dry season. In this study, antibiotic efflux showed the higher proportion in wet season than in dry season. Combined with the change of water temperature, it could be found that the higher water temperature improved the proportion of antibiotic efflux mechanism and weaken the role degree of target alteration and inactivation mechanism. The reason for this phenomenon was that the efflux pump system of bacteria commonly involved in the transport of quorum sensing signals, thereby the enhancement of microbial quorum sensing signals under the higher temperature of wet season is conducive to the transfer of efflux ARGs. (Discussion-p.6); "The results indicated that antibiotic efflux emerged as the predominant resistance pathway in the all samples from wet season (45%–60%), yet the secondary resistance mechanism between the comprehensive river system and reservoir system showed the obvious difference. Antibiotic target alteration and antibiotic inactivation were secondary resistance mechanism of both systems, which account for 22% and 29% of contribution proportions, respectively. In dry season, the dominated resistance mechanism in R1-R3 rivers and reservoir was antibiotic inactivation (37%–52%), and that in R4 and R5 rivers was antibiotic efflux (44%) and antibiotic target alteration (43%), respectively." (Results-p.3-4); "Pearson correlation analysis indicated that TOC concentration showed a significant influence on antibiotic efflux mechanism proportion (R = −0.90; P < 0.01). This result was similar to the found by Lin et al. (2019) who study efflux pump-mediated ciprofloxacin resistance in drinking water under the low nutrient levels. Generally, the overexpression of microbial efflux pump would increase the fitness cost of microbial antibiotic resistance under the condition with the lower TOC concentration, which was not conducive to the survival and enrichment of microorganisms." (Discussion-p.6)

pathogen: 表层水微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: TOC和氨氮浓度对ARG相对丰度有显著正向影响(标准化回归权重分别为1.414和0.700, P<0.05); pH对ARG相对丰度有显著正向影响(标准化回归权重=1.727, P<0.05)
mechanism_chain_original: TOC和氨氮浓度升高 → 为异养细菌(如Bacteroidetes和Actinobacteria, 在宿主菌中占高比例)提供丰富能量 → 保证ARG重组过程中的能量合成成本 → 促进ARG相对丰度增加。在目标河库系统中,异养细菌携带ARGs的比例明显高于自养细菌(如Nitrospirae和Cyanobacteria),TOC对ARG丰度的标准化回归权重(1.414)明显高于氨氮(0.700),提示在低人为污染负荷的亚热带河库系统中,营养盐主要通过提供丰富能量促进细菌耐药性,而不是通过增加细菌繁殖能力(受水温影响)。硝酸盐氮浓度(目标系统主导氮形式)与ARG相对丰度无显著关系,因为在DO浓度较高的表层水中硝酸盐不能参与细菌能量代谢。pH对ARG相对丰度有显著正向影响(标准化回归权重=1.727, P<0.05),但其直接影响权重可能被TOC和DO浓度的潜在间接影响放大。
original_quote: The concentrations of TOC and ammonia nitrogen in the surface water showed the positive influence on ARGs relative abundances, aligning with findings from other freshwater environments. Based on the coping cost theory, the enhancing role of nutrient in ARGs abundance was mainly attributed to increasing the bacterial reproductive capacity under eutrophic conditions that can reduce the host health crisis costs during ARG recombination, and abundant electron donors guaranteeing the synthesis energy cost. In the target river-reservoir system of this study, the heterotrophic bacteria carrying ARGs (such as Bacteroidetes and Actinobacteria) showed the higher proportion than the autotrophic bacteria (such as Nitrospirae and Cyanobacteria), and the standardized regression weight of TOC on the ARGs abundance was obvious higher than ammonia nitrogen. Combining the above results, this study concluded that in the subtropical river-reservoir system with low man-made pollution loading, the nutrients mainly promoted bacterial resistance by providing abundant energy, rather than increasing bacterial reproductive capacity that was affected by water temperature. This found could be proved by the non-significant relationship between ARGs relative abundance and nitrate nitrogen concentration that was the dominated nitrogen form in target system, due to nitrate cannot involve in the bacterial energy metabolism in the surface water with higher DO concentration. (Discussion-p.6-7); "SEM analysis result (Fig. 7) showed that ammonia nitrogen concentration, TOC concentration, water temperature and pH level were the significant direct influence factors on the ARGs abundance (P < 0.05)... Standardized regression weights of ammonia nitrogen concentration, TOC concentration, water temperature and pH level were 0.700, 1.414, 1.447 and 1.727, respectively, which meant pH level was the most important factors. However, given the significant relationships among the different environmental factors, the direct influence weight of pH level on ARGs relative abundance might be amplified by potential indirect effects stemming from TOC and DO concentrations." (Results-p.4)

title: Antibiotic resistant genes profile in the surface water of subtropical drinking water river-reservoir system
pathogen: 表层水微生物(Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes, Actinobacteria)
amr_outcome_original: 优势ARB在不同样点的变化趋势与主导ARG相似; Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes和Actinobacteria在门水平上携带大多数ARGs,分别占74%, 37%和35%
mechanism_chain_original: 季节性温度和营养盐浓度变化 → 影响不同细菌群落的生长和ARGs水平转移能力 → 优势ARB(如Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes, Actinobacteria)作为天然水生环境中的典型细菌群落,具有更高的ARGs水平转移扩增能力 → 导致优势ARB在不同样点的变化趋势与主导ARG相似。湿季Proteobacteria是R2-R5河流和水库的优势ARB(占物种丰度32%-74%),而R1河流的优势ARB为Actinobacteria; 干季Proteobacteria在R1河流(19%)和R4河流(25%)中占最高比例,Actinobacteria在R2-R3河流和水库(RE)中占最高比例(22%, 37%, 28%),Bacteroidetes在R5河流中携带大多数ARGs(35%)。
original_quote: In this study, metagenomic assembly-based host-tracking analysis revealed the obvious higher ARBs proportions in Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes and Actinobacteria compared to other phyla. These species as the typical bacterial communities in natural aquatic environment implied that ARGs in drinking water river-reservoir system have the higher potential amplification capacity by horizontal gene transfer. Indeed, the dominated ARBs in the different samples showed the similar variation tendency with dominated ARGs in this study. (Discussion-p.5); "The host analysis results indicated the 63%–99% of the detected ARGs could be taxonomically annotated bacteria in different samples, and the identified bacterial hosts at phylum level account for 49%–88%. The dominated ARBs in the different samples showed the similar variation tendency with dominated ARGs, namely the similarity of dominated ARBs in wet season was higher than in dry season. In wet season, Proteobacteria emerged as the dominant ARBs, accounting for 32%–74% of species abundance in the R2-R5 rivers and reservoir, while most ARBs in R1 river was classified into Actinobacteria. In dry season, Proteobacteria occupied the highest proportion in the R1 river (19%) and R4 river (25%); Actinobacteria accounting for 22%, 37% and 28% of the total identified hosts in R2-R3 rivers and reservoir (RE), respectively, were identified as the major ARBs of the three sites; while Bacteroidetes harbored most of ARGs in R5 river (35%)." (Results-p.2-3)

title: Antibiotic resistant genes profile in the surface water of subtropical drinking water river-reservoir system
climate_factor_original: 温度-变化 (季节性); 亚硝酸盐氮浓度-变化
pathogen: 表层水微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 亚硝酸盐氮浓度对ARG检测数量有显著影响(P<0.01),贡献48.7%的ARG多样性变化; 湿季和干季ARG检测数量无显著差异(湿季162 vs 干季150)
mechanism_chain_original: 亚硝酸盐氮浓度升高 → 对微生物产生生物毒性应激 → 诱导转座子和插入序列的迁移 → 促进ARGs水平转移 → 提高ARG多样性。RDA结果显示亚硝酸盐氮浓度对ARG检测数量有显著影响(P<0.01),贡献48.7%的ARG多样性变化。然而,湿季和干季ARG检测数量无显著差异(湿季162 vs 干季150),且单个样点ARG检测数量在不同季节呈现不一致变化(如D-R2为161, W-R2为114; W-R3为163, D-R3为133; W-R5为137, D-R5为89),提示随机过程主导ARG多样性变化,但确定性过程(如亚硝酸盐氮浓度)也能部分解释ARG多样性变化。
original_quote: In this study, ARGs detected number was not affected by the seasonal variation, the similar result also be found in the Yellow River basin, and stochastic processes dominated the ARGs transference may be the main reason. However, the significant influence of nitrite nitrogen concentration on the detected number of ARGs implied that the deterministic processes also could partly explain the ARGs diversity variation. Nitrite nitrogen enhancing ARGs diversity may be related to its toxic stress on microorganisms, because the biotoxic stress has been shown to induce the migration of transposons and insertion sequences, which have significant positive influence on the horizontal transfer of ARGs. (Discussion-p.5); "The detected number of the ARGs in the surface water of river-reservoir system from both seasons was shown in Fig. 2-A. The result indicated that a total of 440 ARGs were detected in the samples, with the number of ARGs at individual sites ranging from 89 to 172. Although the total ARGs detected number of the target river-reservoir system in wet season (162) was higher than in dry season (150), this overarching trend was not uniformly reflected across all individual sites. For example, the detected number of ARGs at the R2 river in dry season (D-R2, 161) was higher than in wet season (W-R2, 114), and the ARGs diversities at W-R3 (163) and W-R5 (137) sites exceeded those at D-R3 (133) and D-R5 (89) sites." (Results-p.2); "Based on the above environmental factors, RDA result indicated that the concentrations of nitrite nitrogen and TOC were significant factors explaining the detected number of ARGs (P < 0.01) and various resistance mechanism proportions (P < 0.01), which contributed 48.7% and 61.1% of the ARGs diversity variation, respectively." (Results-p.4)

title: Serotypes, seasonal trends, and antibiotic resistance of non-typhoidal Salmonella from human patients in Guangdong Province, China, 2009–2012
climate_factor_original: 温度-升高; 湿度-升高 (季节性)

title: Serotypes, seasonal trends, and antibiotic resistance of non-typhoidal Salmonella from human patients in Guangdong Province, China, 2009–2012
pathogen: 非伤寒沙门氏菌(NTS, 特别是S. Typhimurium, S. serotype 4,5,12:i:-)
amr_outcome_original: 总体耐药率从2009年逐年上升至2012年; 环丙沙星耐药率从2009年2.4%增至2012年12%; <5岁儿童对头孢菌素耐药率显著高于≥5岁患者

original_quote: Increasing antimicrobial resistance was observed in this study, especially to the conventional first-line agents, such as β-lactam antibiotics and quinolones... Drug resistance in China is likely multifaceted, with resistant isolates selected after environmental, clinical and veterinary antibiotic exposures. Further investigations exploring the emergence of resistant NTS isolates are required to control this public health problem. (Discussion-p.6); "The overall resistance rate to ciprofloxacin increased from 2.4% in 2009 to 12% in 2012 (Figure 1)... Among children <5 years, isolates resistant to cefepime, cefotaxime and caftazidime accounted for 12%, 12% and 8.5% while the resistance rate in patients ≥5 years was 4.7%, 5.5%, and 4.5%, respectively. Resistance to all three cephalosporin antimicrobials was seen in 99 isolates, of which patients <5 years accounted for 90% (89/99) and S. Typhimurium accounted for 46% (45/99). (Abstract & Results-p.5); "In this study, 473 NTS isolates showed the ACSSuT resistance pattern. S. Typhimurium accounted for 60% (284/473) followed by S. serotype 4,5,12:i:- (21%, 101/473). title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
climate_factor_original: 降水-增加 (5月集中降雨); 温度-升高 (5月19-26°C)
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 5月富营养化程度高但ARG丰度低; 9月富营养化程度低但ARG丰度高
mechanism_chain_original: 5月集中降雨(伴有强降水事件) → 加速农业径流中污染物(TN, TP)进入水体 → 导致5月富营养化程度显著高于9月(TN: 2.41-3.37 mg/L, Chl-a显著高于国家标准, COD和BOD5显著高于9月, DO显著低于9月) → 但5月强降水同时显著稀释水体中ARG浓度 → 导致5月ARG丰度低于9月。9月温度较高(比5月高约5°C)且降雨较少 → 底层水温较高和更有利的水混合条件 → 促进微生物活性和水平基因转移(HGT) → 导致9月ARG丰度(磺胺类和四环素类)显著高于5月(Table 1: 9月磺胺类0.31-0.73 copies/16S rRNA vs 5月0.13-0.6; 9月四环素类0.52-2.5 vs 5月0.42-1.91)。
original_quote: The average temperature in Nanjing from May to September ranges from 19 to 26 °C, which provides a better environment for algae growth. Precipitation in May is more concentrated than in September and is often accompanied by heavy precipitation events. These precipitation events may accelerate the entry of pollutants from agricultural runoff into the water column, resulting in higher pollutant concentrations, which may increase the degree of eutrophication in the water column. (Results-p.9-10); "Our results showed that the eutrophication of water bodies was higher in May than in September, but the abundance of ARG pollution was higher in September than in May. This may be related to higher bottom water temperatures and more favorable water-mixing conditions in September. In this case, low concentrations of ammonia and phosphate instead favored the proliferation of ARGs, while higher concentrations of nitrogen and phosphorus may have inhibited their proliferation. Thus, high concentrations of nitrogen and phosphorus in May resulted in low concentrations of ARGs." (Discussion-p.11-12); "The concentrations of sulfonamide resistance genes and tetracycline resistance genes in September were significantly higher than those in May, indicating that seasonal variations significantly impacted the ARG concentration, which might be related to the heavy rainfall. In Nanjing, the precipitation was more concentrated in May than in September, and the degree of eutrophication in the water bodies was higher in May than in September. On the one hand, the heavy rainfall delivered new ARGs into the aquatic environment through surface runoff, and, on the other hand, the heavy rainfall significantly diluted the concentration of ARGs in the water bodies." (Results-p.16)

title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
climate_factor_original: 降水-变化 (季节性); 温度-变化 (季节性)
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
mechanism_chain_original: DO浓度降低(5月DO: 5.34-6.46 mg/L, 9月DO: 6.64-8.47 mg/L) → 低DO条件下营养物质(TN, TP, COD)从沉积物释放进入水体 → 为微生物生长和ARG增殖提供有利条件 → 导致DO与ARG丰度呈负相关(Figures 4 and 5)。BOD与DO呈显著负相关(p<0.001),表明水体BOD随DO降低而显著增加。
original_quote: According to other related studies, DO is negatively correlated with the abundance of ARGs (Figures 4 and 5). We believe this could be because nutrients are released from sediments in low DO conditions, leading to higher concentrations of TN, TP, and COD, which provide favorable conditions for the proliferation of ARGs. Lower DO levels may cause nutrients to be released into the water, potentially promoting the spread of antibiotic resistance genes. (Discussion-p.11-12); "This effect was also reflected in the decrease in DO concentrations in the May water samples, which were relatively high in September. A significant negative correlation (p < 0.001) between BOD and DO indicates that the BOD of the water body increased significantly with the decrease in DO (Figures 2 and 3)." (Results-p.10)

title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: Chl-a与ARG丰度呈负相关; 富营养化环境中藻类过度生长可能抑制ARG传播
mechanism_chain_original: 富营养化导致藻类过度生长(Chl-a浓度显著高于国家标准) → 藻类生长对ARG携带细菌产生竞争性抑制效应 → 改变微生物群落结构,可能有利于非ARG携带菌种 → 导致Chl-a与ARG丰度呈负相关或弱相关(Figures 4 and 5),特别是Chl-a与sul基因呈显著负相关。
original_quote: The Chl-a concentration was negatively or weakly correlated with antibiotics, contrary to the general rule that a higher Chl-a concentration means poorer water quality and a higher ARG concentration. This suggests that although nutrients significantly influence antibiotics in the water environment, the overgrowth of algae during eutrophication may inhibit the spread of ARGs. Chl-a was significantly negatively correlated with sul genes (Figures 4 and 5), which is in agreement with the results of the study on the Yangtze River estuary. This may be related to the longer water residence time and eutrophication status, reflecting the competitive inhibitory effect of algal growth in eutrophic environments, weakening the diffusion ability of ARG-carrying bacteria in the microbial community. (Discussion-p.12); "The negative correlation between Chl-a and ARGs suggests that algal blooms may exert competitive inhibitory effects on ARG-carrying bacteria. During periods of high eutrophication, rapid algal growth can alter the microbial community structure, potentially favoring non-ARG-carrying species." (Discussion-p.14)

title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 重金属(Cd, Cr, Cu, Zn, Pb)与ARG丰度呈不同相关性,促进ARG增殖
mechanism_chain_original: 重金属(Cd, Cr, Cu, Zn, Pb)通过工业排放、农业活动和交通污染进入环境 → 重金属对微生物产生选择压力 → 1) Cd诱导氧化应激,激活外排泵(如tetA和tetX)排出四环素,促进细菌存活并增加ARG流行率; Cd抑制硫酸盐还原菌的硫代谢,可能降低sul2基因丰度; 2) Cr(VI)诱导氧化应激,触发DNA损伤,通过整合酶活性促进耐药基因(如sul1和tetE)的转移; 3) Cu和Zn产生活性氧,促使细菌上调外排泵(如tetX和tetD)排出金属和抗生素,促进金属应激下的细菌存活; 金属耐受基因和抗生素耐药基因通常位于同一质粒或整合子上,促进共选择; 4) Pb造成氧化损伤,可选择耐受应激的细菌,共选择sul1、tetA和tetC耐药基因; Pb与tetE呈负相关,可能由于特定微生物群落动态或干扰结合机制 → 导致Cd与tetX和tetA正相关但与sul2负相关; Cr与sul1和tetE显著正相关; Cu和Zn与tetX和tetD正相关; Pb与sul1、tetA和tetC正相关但可能与tetE负相关(Figures 4 and 5)。
original_quote: Metals and antibiotics accelerate the spread of antibiotic-resistant bacteria (ARB)-carrying antibiotic-resistance genes (ARGs) by exerting selective pressure on bacteria, which in turn exacerbates the spread of ARGs in the ecosystem. Cr, Cu, Cd, Pb, and Zn released from industrial emissions, agricultural activities, and transportation pollution enter the environment through rainwater runoff, atmospheric deposition, and other pathways. These heavy metals showed different correlations with ARGs. Cd was positively correlated with tetX and tetA, but negatively correlated with sul2 (Figures 4 and 5). Cd induces oxidative stress in bacterial cells, activating efflux pumps like tetA and tetX, which expel tetracyclines, promoting bacterial survival and increasing ARG prevalence. In contrast, Cd inhibits sulfur metabolism in sulfate-reducing bacteria, potentially reducing sul2 gene abundance. Additionally, Cd interferes with biofilm formation, further hindering the proliferation of sulfonamide-resistant bacteria. Cr was significantly positively correlated with sul1 and tetE; Cu and Zn were positively correlated with tetX and tetD; and Pb was positively correlated with sul1, tetA, and tetC, but possibly negatively correlated with tetE (Figures 4 and 5). Cr, particularly Cr(VI), induces oxidative stress, triggering DNA damage and promoting the transfer of resistance genes like sul1 and tetE via integrase activity, enhancing gene spread in bacterial communities exposed to chronic Cr stress. Cu and Zn generate reactive oxygen species, prompting bacteria to upregulate efflux pumps like tetX and tetD to expel metals and antibiotics, facilitating bacterial survival under metal stress. Metal tolerance genes and antibiotic resistance genes often reside on the same plasmids or integrons, promoting co-selection and increasing the likelihood of resistance in contaminated environments. Pb causes oxidative damage and can select bacteria that tolerate stress, co-selecting sul1, tetA, and tetC resistance genes due to their association with mobile genetic elements. The negative correlation between Pb and tetE may arise from specific microbial community dynamics or interference with conjugation mechanisms, shifting the resistance profile toward other mechanisms. Thus, Pb could select alternative resistance strategies, reducing the prominence of tetE. These heavy metals alter the microbial community structure, and heavy metals with substantial toxicity and antioxidant properties, such as Cr, trigger microbial stress responses, selectively promote the proliferation of drug-resistant bacteria, enhance the adaptability of bacteria-harboring resistance genes, and promote the spread of resistance genes. (Discussion-p.14-15)

title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: sul基因与intl1显著正相关; intl1促进ARG水平转移
mechanism_chain_original: sul基因(sul1, sul2)易被intl1(class 1 integron基因)捕获 → sul基因主要由整合子(intl1)携带 → intl1作为人为污染诱导的ARG选择压力标志物 → intl1通过水平基因转移(HGT)促进抗生素耐药性的广泛传播 → 导致sul基因与intl1显著正相关(Figures S1 and S2),特别是在赵桥水库9月sul1与intl1呈强正相关,强调其在塑造ARG谱中的重要性。高intl1丰度揭示HGT可能在多种环境介质中发生,进一步促进抗生素耐药基因在不同生态系统中的传播。
original_quote: Based on the correlation between antibiotics and resistance genes, sul was significantly positively correlated with intl1 (Figures S1 and S2), probably because the resistance genes of sulfonamide antibiotics were easily captured by intl1, and sul genes were mainly carried by integrons (intl1). The PCA findings also revealed that sul1 was consistently correlated with intl1 across all the reservoirs, underscoring the role of mobile genetic elements in spreading sulfonamide resistance genes. Notably, in Zhaoqiao Reservoir, sul1 showed a strong positive correlation with intl1 in September, emphasizing its importance in shaping ARG profiles during this season. This conclusion is further supported by the fact that higher abundances of sul1 and sul2 were also detected in studies on the Minxin River in Shijiazhuang and the Liao River in northeast China. The current study suggests that mobile integrons play an important role in spreading antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs), especially in regard to environmental pollution, where they promote the level and spread of ARGs. (Results-p.16-17); "The integron intl1, a marker of anthropogenic contamination-induced selective pressure on ARGs, can facilitate the extensive spread of antibiotic resistance through horizontal gene transfer. Higher int1 abundance revealed that horizontal gene transfer may occur in multiple environmental media, further promoting the spread of antibiotic resistance genes in different ecosystems." (Results-p.17)

title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带tetM, tetO, sul1, sul2的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: tetO和tetC丰度较高; 施用粪肥土壤中tetM, tetO, sul1, sul2丰度较高
mechanism_chain_original: 农业活动(如土壤施肥,特别是施用含抗生素残留的粪肥或有机肥) → 含抗生素残留的粪肥或有机肥在种植季节(通常与春末或初夏一致,如5月)达峰 → 5月集中降雨导致含抗生素残留的径流更高地流入水体 → 导致tetO和tetC丰度较高,可能与农业活动密切相关。施用粪肥土壤中四环素和磺胺类基因(如tetM, tetO, sul1, sul2)丰度较高,表明农业活动是四环素耐药基因的最重要来源之一。
original_quote: In the tetracycline resistance genes (tet genes) analysis, tetC was generally the most abundant in the water column, while tetA and tetX were detected at a lower frequency. Moreover, tetO and tetC had a higher abundance, which may be closely related to agricultural activities, such as soil fertilization. In particular, the abundance of tetracycline and sulfonamide genes (e.g., tetM, tetO, sul1, sul2) was higher in soils with manure application, suggesting that agricultural activities are one of the most important sources of tetracycline resistance genes. (Results-p.17); "The seasonal variation in sulfamethazine concentrations may be linked to its widespread use in agriculture and aquaculture practices. Globally, sulfamethazine is commonly used in veterinary medicine to treat bacterial infections in livestock, as well as in aquaculture and crop farming to prevent disease outbreaks. Manure or organic fertilizers containing antibiotic residues peak during planting in many regions, often coinciding with late spring or early summer. These practices can lead to higher runoff of sulfamethazine into water bodies during increased precipitation, such as in May in the areas in our study." (Discussion-p.17)

title: Linking Antibiotic Residues and Antibiotic Resistance Genes to Water Quality Parameters in Urban Reservoirs: A Seasonal Perspective
pathogen: 水体微生物(携带ARGs的细菌)
amr_outcome_original: 磺胺甲嗪(sulfamethazine)在5月显著高于9月; 其他抗生素(如四环素、磺胺二嗪、磺胺甲氧嘧啶)无显著季节性差异
mechanism_chain_original: 磺胺甲嗪在兽医实践中广泛使用,特别是在畜牧业、水产养殖和作物种植中用于治疗细菌感染和预防疾病暴发 → 含抗生素残留的粪肥或有机肥在种植季节(通常与春末或初夏一致,如5月)应用达峰 → 5月集中降雨导致磺胺甲嗪通过径流更高地流入水体 → 导致山湖水库磺胺甲嗪从5月2.15 ng/L显著降至9月1.23 ng/L (p=0.01),赵桥水库从5月1.13 ng/L显著降至9月0.71 ng/L (p=0.03)。其他抗生素(如四环素、磺胺二嗪、磺胺甲氧嘧啶)无显著季节性差异,表明持续污染来自持续来源(如畜牧业或废水排放),强调其环境稳定性和抗降解性。
original_quote: The sulfamethazine concentrations decreased significantly in Shanhu (from 2.15 ng/L in May to 1.23 ng/L in September, p = 0.01) and Zhaoqiao (from 1.13 ng/L in May to 0.71 ng/L in September, p = 0.03). These reductions suggest that sulfamethazine contamination is highly sensitive to seasonal factors, likely influenced by agricultural runoff patterns. Sulfamethazine is commonly used in veterinary practices, and its decline during the drier months of September may reflect reduced application or leaching into water bodies during this period. (Results-p.18); "The seasonal variation in sulfamethazine concentrations may be linked to its widespread use in agriculture and aquaculture practices. Globally, sulfamethazine is commonly used in veterinary medicine to treat bacterial infections in livestock, as well as in aquaculture and crop farming to prevent disease outbreaks. Manure or organic fertilizers containing antibiotic residues peak during planting in many regions, often coinciding with late spring or early summer. These practices can lead to higher runoff of sulfamethazine into water bodies during increased precipitation, such as in May in the areas in our study.
